summary.note: Every card is voiced: passive-rule nerfs and passive-kind buffs play their family soundCue on spawn (see sounds.ts playPassiveCue); instant/activated buffs voice through the cast/signature system (playCardUse + signature voices). Fields are derived, not hand-authored.

cards.name: Bishop Polish
cards.description: One bishop can jump exactly one piece, once.

cards.name: Butterfingers
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Ancient Custom
cards.description: The old law never expired: once, one of your pawns may capture an enemy pawn standing directly beside it en passant, as though it had just double-stepped. (Reaching your last rank this way promotes to a queen.)

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: No peasant may slay a king: enemy pawns can never capture your king, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Bishop's Blessing
cards.description: The clergy is above the cavalry's reach: enemy knights can never capture your bishops, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: First Blood
cards.description: The first capture you make in the game steals 10 seconds from your opponent's clock and adds them to yours. In untimed games it collects nothing.

cards.name: Postern Gate
cards.description: An old side door swings open in the keep wall: your right to castle on both sides is restored, even if your king or rooks have already moved.

cards.name: Castle Early
cards.description: Castle even if your king has already moved once.

cards.name: Cold Feet
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Cold Open
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their queen for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece (not the king) for 1 of its owner's turns.

cards.name: Cornerstone
cards.description: Your rooks cannot be captured while on their starting squares.

cards.name: Crossed Wires
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Deep Breath
cards.description: Free action: ignore your nerf for one move, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Diagonal Step
cards.description: Your king moves like a bishop for one move.

cards.name: Drawbridge
cards.description: Your opponent cannot castle for their next 6 turns.

cards.name: Escape Hatch
cards.description: Your king swaps places with one of its own pawns, once.

cards.name: Extra Glance
cards.description: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Ferz King
cards.description: Your king may move two squares diagonally, once per game.

cards.name: Firm Footing
cards.description: Choose one piece: it and your pawns on the squares beside it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Foggy Glasses
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Free Retreat
cards.description: Return your last-moved piece to the square it came from, once.

cards.name: Guarded King
cards.description: Enemy pieces cannot move to the squares diagonally adjacent to your king for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Half Step
cards.description: One pawn moves diagonally forward without capturing, once.

cards.name: Heavy Boots
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot double-step for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Holy Hell
cards.description: Your pawns can never be captured en passant, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Bad Omen
cards.description: A dark omen is read over their camp: on your opponent's 3rd turn from now, it strikes, and for that one turn they may move only a pawn or their king. They can see it coming and set up around it.

cards.name: Cold Footprints
cards.description: The ground remembers their tread: for your opponent's next 5 turns, whenever they move a piece, the square it left is frozen over for their following turn, and no enemy piece may step onto it. Retracing their own steps is what the curse hates most.

cards.name: Witch's Veto
cards.description: The witch forbids revenge: for your opponent's next 4 turns, they cannot capture the piece you moved on your previous turn. Everything else is fair game: they can attack other pieces, or simply wait a turn for the veto to move on.

cards.name: No Retreat
cards.description: A banner of no surrender is nailed up: for your opponent's next 5 turns, none of their pieces may move toward their own back rank (no retreating or sidestepping backward). They may advance or move straight across; the king is exempt, and a piece with no forward move is freed for that turn. Wait it out, or press forward on the curse's own terms.

cards.name: Overexertion
cards.description: The curse hates a workhorse: for your opponent's next 5 turns, whenever they move the same piece they moved on their previous turn, it seizes up and is frozen for 1 of their turns. Simply alternating which piece they develop avoids it completely. Kings never seize.

cards.name: Toll Road
cards.description: A toll is set on the border: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any turn they move a piece out of their own half and into yours, their following turn is taxed - they may move only a pawn or their king. Developing at home is free; invading costs a beat of tempo. Kings crossing pay the same toll.

cards.name: Wrong Foot
cards.description: Their dance is thrown off: for your opponent's next 4 turns, each piece they move must land on a square of the opposite color to wherever they landed last turn (light, then dark, then light). Their king is exempt, and if no legal move fits the pattern they may move freely that turn. Plan the sequence and it costs nothing.

cards.name: I Hate My Ex
cards.description: Freeze one enemy pawn for 2 turns, but you get so worked up you freeze your own nearest pawn for 2 turns too. Mostly self-inflicted.

cards.name: Knock Knees
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on the rim for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Little Leap
cards.description: One pawn jumps a single blocking piece directly ahead, once.

cards.name: Tight Formation
cards.description: Pawns still standing on your second rank cannot be captured, for the game. Once a pawn steps forward it is on its own.

cards.name: Loyal Pawn
cards.description: One pawn promotes on your 7th rank instead of your 8th.

cards.name: Molasses
cards.description: Your opponent's queen slides at most 3 squares for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Nudge
cards.description: Push one enemy pawn back one square if empty behind, once.

cards.name: Pawn Shield
cards.description: One pawn cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Peek
cards.description: Gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Prep
cards.description: Your next buff draft shows three cards to pick from instead of two, once.

cards.name: Quick Glance
cards.description: Your opponent loses one draft reroll, if they still hold one.

cards.name: Quiet March
cards.description: One pawn can move backward one square, once.

cards.name: Reprieve
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Rook Slide
cards.description: One rook moves one square diagonally, once.

cards.name: Royal Restraint
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.description: One captured pawn returns to an empty square on your 2nd rank, once.

cards.name: Sentinel Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may capture an enemy piece two squares diagonally ahead, once.

cards.name: Sidestep
cards.description: Choose one piece: it steps one square to an empty square beside it and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Slippery Grip
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks slide at most 3 squares for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Small Mercies
cards.description: The next 2 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Stage Fright
cards.description: Your opponent cannot promote a pawn for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Steady Hand
cards.description: Enemy knights cannot move to squares that attack your king for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Steady March
cards.description: Two pawns each advance one square immediately.

cards.name: Stiff Joints
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot move diagonally for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Tempo Shuffle
cards.description: Move one pawn sideways one square, once.

cards.name: Toll Gate
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture en passant for their next 6 turns.

cards.name: Walnut Shell
cards.description: Crack it open: free one of your pieces from any freeze or walnut hex.

cards.name: Watchtower
cards.description: The tower spots the cavalry a mile out: enemy knights cannot move into your half of the board for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Updraft
cards.description: One knight may make a longer 3-by-1 leap, once.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.description: One piece cannot be pushed or swapped by enemy buffs, for the game.

cards.name: Apple
cards.description: Feed one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns and may immediately step one square to an empty square beside it.

cards.name: Banana Peel
cards.description: Toss peels on two empty squares, visible to both players. The first enemy piece other than the king to step on each slips one square back toward its home rank and is too dazed to move on its owner's next turn.

cards.name: Blunted Lance
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on any square defended by one of your pawns, for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Bubble Wrap
cards.description: Shrink-wrap one of your own pieces: it cannot be captured for 3 turns, but it can only move for the last of them. Your king cannot be chosen.

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.description: Two pawns in front of your king cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Butter Bishops
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops slide at most 2 squares for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Pioneer's Banner
cards.description: The next 3 times one of your pieces (your king excepted) crosses from your half into your opponent's half, it plants the banner: that piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Scarecrow
cards.description: Prop a scarecrow on an empty square in your half: it stands there as one of your pawns but is rooted and can never move, for the rest of the game. It blocks lines for both sides and can be captured like any pawn.

cards.name: Heir Apparent
cards.description: The line of succession is settled in advance: the first time your opponent captures one of your knights or bishops, your pawn nearest your home rank is knighted into that same kind of piece where it stands.

cards.name: Home Guard
cards.description: The threshold is warded for good: no enemy piece may ever move onto your first rank. Your back rank stays yours, and no enemy pawn can promote on it.

cards.name: King's Shield
cards.description: The king's own shieldbearer never falls first: your piece standing on the square directly in front of your king cannot be captured. Whichever piece holds that square is protected while it stays there.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.description: Shoulder to shoulder they cannot be broken: any of your pawns that stands directly beside another of your pawns (on the next file over, same rank) cannot be captured. A lone pawn is on its own.

cards.name: Camel Knight
cards.description: One knight also moves as a camel (3-1 leap), for the game.

cards.name: Chill Guy
cards.description: He's just a chill guy: every freeze and every walnut currently stuck to YOUR pieces melts off, and you take 1 extra move. A free action. Lowkey he doesn't even care.

cards.name: Coconut Bonk
cards.description: Drop a coconut on one enemy piece: it is stunned and cannot move for its next turn. Kings are too hard-headed.

cards.name: Counterstep
cards.description: After your opponent's next capture, you take two moves in reply, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Cut Purse
cards.description: Steal one of your opponent's unspent cards of tier 1. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Decoy
cards.description: Summon a decoy on an empty square in your half, and your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Defiance
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf until your opponent's next capture, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Battering Line
cards.description: Your pawns can capture straight ahead for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Draft Insight
cards.description: Your next draft is fated to offer tier 3 cards.

cards.name: Emotional Support Pawn
cards.description: A small round friend refuses to leave your side: place a new pawn on an empty square right beside your king.

cards.name: Evil Eye
cards.description: One enemy piece you choose cannot capture anything for 4 of their turns. It may still move. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Fly Swatter
cards.description: One enemy knight is stunned for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Fork Guard
cards.description: Whenever one of your knights gives check, it cannot be captured on the reply turn.

cards.name: Gargoyles
cards.description: Petrify one of your opponent's bishops for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Ghost Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may advance two squares by passing through a single enemy piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond without capturing, once.

cards.name: Hard Reset
cards.description: Turn it off and on again: your opponent's most advanced pawn is sent back to its starting square, if that square is free. Ties reboot the pawn nearest the a-file.

cards.name: Held Breath
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Hunter's Relief
cards.description: Your next 2 captures each suspend your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.description: A price is set on your blood: the next time your opponent captures one of your pieces within their next 6 turns, they must skip their following turn while the debt is collected. If they hold their blades for 6 turns, the price expires unpaid.

cards.name: The Long Road Home
cards.description: Lay a calling on one enemy knight, bishop or rook: every move it makes must bring it closer to its own back rank. The curse lifts the moment it stands on that rank; otherwise it fades after 6 of their turns. Their other pieces are free; the victim can simply obey, stand still, or be played around.

cards.name: Tarnished Crown
cards.description: Their coronations are cursed: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn they promote arrives exhausted: the new piece is frozen for 2 of their turns the moment it is crowned. They can wait the curse out or pay the price knowingly.

cards.name: Binding Oath
cards.description: Swear two enemy pieces to a pact of restraint: for your opponent's next 6 turns, so long as both still stand, neither of the pair may capture anything. The oath breaks the instant one of them leaves the board, freeing the survivor. They can trade one away to release the other, or simply attack with their other pieces. Kings cannot be sworn.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: A taste for blood takes hold: for your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece that captures is seized by frenzy and, on their very next turn, must capture again if any capture is open to it. If that piece has no capture available, the frenzy passes and they move freely. Capturing with a piece that cannot follow up, or not capturing at all, keeps them in control.

cards.name: Handed Down
cards.description: A clinging curse settles on one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns the bearer is hobbled and may move at most 2 squares at a time. Trading it away does not end the curse - the moment you capture the bearer, the curse leaps to whichever of their pieces is nearest. To be rid of it they must strand the bearer far from the rest of the army, then let it die alone. Kings never take it.

cards.name: Fifth Column
cards.description: Turn one enemy pawn to your cause: it fights under your banner for your next 3 turns, then its conscience returns and it goes back to your opponent. You move it on your turns; if it is captured while it serves you, the plot simply ends. Kings and other pieces are beyond the recruiter's reach.

cards.name: Slow Poison
cards.description: Slip poison into one enemy queen, rook or bishop. In 4 of their turns it withers a full rank: a queen sinks to a rook, a rook to a bishop, a bishop to a knight. One dose of blood is the antidote: if the poisoned piece captures anything before then, the poison is purged. They see the fuse the whole time - feed it a capture, trade the piece off, or let it wither.

cards.name: Imp Familiar
cards.description: A smug little imp perches on an empty square of your back rank and fights as a bishop for 3 of your turns, then scampers back through the veil.

cards.name: King's Guard
cards.description: Add a pawn to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Lame Horses
cards.description: Your opponent's knights go lame and refuse to turn around: they cannot move backward for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Leaden Queen
cards.description: Your opponent's queen can only capture at arm's length: her captures must be exactly one square away, for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Long Castle Anywhere
cards.description: Regain castling rights, and queenside castling ignores the b-file square.

cards.name: Long Knight
cards.description: One knight makes two knight-leaps in a single move, once.

cards.name: Loosen the Leash
cards.description: Each of your next 3 captures loosens the leash: your nerf is suspended for your following turn.

cards.name: Mind Nudge
cards.description: Force one enemy pawn to advance one square where empty, once.

cards.name: Minor Recall
cards.description: Return a captured knight or bishop to your back rank, once.

cards.name: No Man's Land
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Onett
cards.description: A townsperson reports for duty: a new pawn takes the nearest open square on your pawn line, or just ahead of it if the line is packed.

cards.name: Oracle's Eye
cards.description: The oracle inhales the vapors and names a better price: your bank offer improves by one tier.

cards.name: Pawn Push
cards.description: On any turn, one of your pawns with two empty squares ahead may advance two squares in a single move, even after it has left its starting square, for the game.

cards.name: Pawn Storm
cards.description: Every one of your pawns still on its starting square advances one square, if the square ahead is empty.

cards.name: Phase Rook
cards.description: Choose one rook. For the game it may pass through one friendly piece per move; it still cannot capture friendly pieces or phase through two.

cards.name: Piece Swap
cards.description: Swap positions of any two of your own pieces, once.

cards.name: Pinned Down
cards.description: Freeze one targeted enemy piece, never the king, for 2 of their turns. As it thaws it stays a heavy walnut for 1 more turn, able only to shuffle a single square.

cards.name: Rake
cards.description: One wide swing: every enemy pawn standing beside a piece you choose is raked one square back toward its home rank, wherever that square is free.

cards.name: Rally
cards.description: One of your knights may move like a king for 1 turn.

cards.name: Recall
cards.description: Return one piece to any empty square in your back two ranks, once.

cards.name: Reinforce
cards.description: One of your pieces cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Reposition
cards.description: Move one piece, your king included, one square in any direction to an empty square, once. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Rusted Hinges
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Safe Passage
cards.description: The roads along the edge are under truce: your opponent cannot capture anything standing on the outer rim of the board, for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Screen
cards.description: Choose one bishop. While it stands on a square next to your king it cannot be captured, for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Sealed Orders
cards.description: Your opponent's next two draft offers contain no draft-manipulation cards.

cards.name: Seized Axles
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways for their next 4 turns: they may only slide up and down their own file.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.description: One of your pieces slips through shadow to a nearby empty square and cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, once.

cards.name: Shielded Advance
cards.description: Choose one pawn. While it stands in the enemy half it cannot be captured, for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Short Leash
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Sidestep King
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for 1 turn.

cards.name: Slack in the Chain
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: A famously bad card. Your whole army goes sluggish: for your next turn every piece can move only one square. It shrugs, apologetically.

cards.name: Snowball
cards.description: One enemy pawn is frozen for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Spring Pawn
cards.description: Your pawns can spring one square sideways onto an empty square, twice.

cards.name: Stone Hooves
cards.description: Petrify one of your opponent's knights for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Stream Sniper
cards.description: You found their stream: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your own next draft shows three cards to pick from.

cards.name: Summon Intern
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the intern quietly takes over the empty desk: a pawn joins your pocket, to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn.

cards.name: Teleport Knight
cards.description: Move one knight to any empty square within the 3x3 box around it, once. It cannot capture with this move.

cards.name: Third Eye
cards.description: Your third eye opens onto what is still hidden: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Timid King
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot end a move beside any of your pieces, for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Trade Up
cards.description: The next time you lose a minor piece, a new pawn appears in your half.

cards.name: Trench Line
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 3 turns. They may still capture diagonally.

cards.name: Undying Thrall
cards.description: Bind a restless spirit into service: one of your captured knights or bishops claws back onto an empty square of your back rank and fights for 5 of your turns, then crumbles to dust, once.

cards.name: Vault
cards.description: One rook jumps its own pawn to the far side, once.

cards.name: 25 Inch Waist
cards.description: Lean and nimble: each of your pawns may also slip diagonally forward one square onto empty ground, no capture needed, wiggling past the traffic.

cards.name: Wazir Bishop
cards.description: Choose one bishop; for the game it may also step one square horizontally or vertically.

cards.name: Wazir Rook
cards.description: Choose one rook; for the game it may also step one square diagonally.

cards.name: Kangaroo Hop
cards.description: One of your knights takes a little kangaroo hop: it may also step one square in any direction, once.

cards.name: Shy Pieces
cards.description: Your opponent's pieces are too shy to approach the crown: for their next 2 turns none of them may move onto a square touching your king.

cards.name: Cinder Strike
cards.description: Remove one of your opponent's pawns from the board, once.

cards.name: Frost Nip
cards.description: Frost nips at the rearguard: every enemy piece except the king still standing on its own back rank is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Regrow
cards.description: One of your captured pawns sprouts back on your 4th rank, or the nearest rank with room, already pointed at promotion.

cards.name: Thunder Step
cards.description: One rook may move up to two squares diagonally, once.

cards.name: Whoopee Cushion
cards.description: Hide a whoopee cushion on an empty square. The first enemy piece other than the king to land on it makes a rude noise and must move that same piece again on their next 2 turns. Then the cushion is done.

cards.name: Field Hospital
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your knights, a new pawn is raised on an empty square of your back rank.

cards.name: Pikemen
cards.description: One of your pawns may also move and capture one square sideways, for the game.

cards.name: Reclaim the Fallen
cards.description: Battlefield salvage: the next 2 enemy pawns you capture are pressed into service, joining your pocket to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Regroup the Lines
cards.description: Sound the recall: every one of your pieces standing in the enemy half falls back one square toward home, wherever the square behind it is free.

cards.name: Allergies
cards.description: One enemy piece other than the king comes down with the sniffles. On each of your opponent's next 3 turns there is a chance it sneezes and cannot move that turn. Their other pieces are unaffected.

cards.name: Anchored Rooks
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their rooks for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Anvil Drop
cards.description: Drop an ACME anvil on one enemy piece: it is flattened and cannot move for 3 of their turns, and the impact knocks it one square back toward its home rank. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Banner of War
cards.description: Raise the banner and your cavalry surges: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king.

cards.name: Basilisk's Gaze
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece to stone: it becomes a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for 4 of their turns, and while petrified it cannot capture. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Berolina Pawns
cards.description: Your pawns may also step diagonally forward to empty squares and capture straight ahead, for the game.

cards.name: Bishop to Archbishop
cards.description: One bishop also moves like a knight, for the game.

cards.name: Blinkered Bishops
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their bishops for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Board Lock
cards.description: The whole board seizes up: no enemy piece may travel more than 3 squares in a single move, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Board Quake
cards.description: Push every enemy pawn back one square where empty behind.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.description: Add a knight to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Boneca Ambalabu
cards.description: The tire-frog drags your opponent down: for their next 4 turns none of their pieces may move more than 1 square in a single move.

cards.name: Boxing Glove
cards.description: A spring-loaded glove punches one enemy piece one square back toward its own side and stuns it for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Break the Nerf
cards.description: Free action: break your nerf, suspending it for your next 3 turns, and take one extra move the moment it breaks.

cards.name: Bunker
cards.description: Three squares in front of your king are barred to enemies for 4 turns.

cards.name: Ascetic's Bargain
cards.description: Take a vow of refusal: your next draft is skipped outright. The draft after that shows three cards to pick from and rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.description: The next time one of your pieces makes a capture, it strikes and slips straight back to the square it came from, dodging any reprisal. Once.

cards.name: Jester's Rule
cards.description: The court demands variety: for your opponent's next 6 turns, they can never capture the same kind of piece their previous move just captured.

cards.name: Double Down
cards.description: Push it all onto the next hand: your next draft shows three cards and you keep all three of them. In return, the draft after that is skipped.

cards.name: Field Knighting
cards.description: Knighted on the battlefield, no cathedral required: choose one of your pawns that has advanced at least to the middle of the board (its fifth rank or beyond) and it becomes a knight where it stands.

cards.name: Forced March
cards.description: Sound the double-quick: for your next 2 turns, any of your pawns may advance two squares in one move from wherever it stands (both squares ahead must be empty), not only from its starting rank. It cannot double-step onto the final rank.

cards.name: Praetorian
cards.description: The guard never leaves her side: your queen cannot be captured while at least one of your knights or bishops stands on a square adjacent to her. Cut down her escort and the guard is gone.

cards.name: Underdog's Gambit
cards.description: Desperation sharpens the rank and file: while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your pawns may also capture an enemy piece standing directly beside them, one square to the left or right. Draw level and they fight like pawns again.

cards.name: Cannon
cards.description: Choose one rook. For the game it keeps its normal moves and may also capture along a rank or file by jumping exactly one piece of either color and taking the first enemy piece beyond it.

cards.name: Chain Mail
cards.description: All your minor pieces are uncapturable for 2 full turns.

cards.name: Clone
cards.description: Run one of your pawns through the photocopier: place an exact copy on an empty square within two squares of it, once.

cards.name: Cream Pie
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture on their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Scratch Card
cards.description: Scratch off three panels with the edge of a coin. Match all three for a knight in your pocket. Match two for 30 seconds. Three blanks and the dud ticket costs you your weakest pawn.

cards.name: Ctrl+Z
cards.description: Undo. One of your captured pawns, knights, or bishops returns to an empty square in your half, once.

cards.name: Deflect
cards.description: Your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Dragon Pawn
cards.description: One pawn moves as a pawn or knight until it promotes.

cards.name: Durian
cards.description: Lob the king of fruits onto an empty square: for your opponent's next 3 turns no enemy piece may move onto a square next to it. The stench clears after that.

cards.name: Fortress
cards.description: One piece standing next to your king becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 4 turns. Your king itself is not shielded.

cards.name: Frost
cards.description: Freeze two adjacent enemy pieces for 1 turn each.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 3 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Glamour
cards.description: The courts trade changelings: one enemy pawn you choose joins your army, and one of your pawns you choose joins theirs.

cards.name: Gorgon's Glance
cards.description: Turn one enemy knight or bishop you target into a walnut: 2 of their turns if it stands in its own half, 4 if it was caught in yours, where the gaze is strongest.

cards.name: Grace Period
cards.description: Suspend your nerf entirely for 4 turns.

cards.name: Grasshopper
cards.description: Choose one non-king piece. For the game it may also move along any rank, file, or diagonal and land on the square immediately beyond the first piece in its path, capturing an enemy piece that stands there.

cards.name: Gremlins
cards.description: For their next 4 turns, your opponent's rooks can only move an even number of squares.

cards.name: Guard Rotation
cards.description: Swap your king with a rook anywhere on the board, once.

cards.name: Half Measure
cards.description: Cut your nerf to half strength: it is suspended on every other one of your next several turns.

cards.name: Hallowed Return
cards.description: A prayer is answered exactly: one of your captured knights, bishops, or rooks is restored to life on one of its own starting squares, if one is free, once.

cards.name: Handstand Pushup
cards.description: Flip one pawn upside down. Forever it may also step and capture straight back or diagonally back toward your own side, but never onto its own back rank.

cards.name: Hobbled Cavalry
cards.description: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Curse of Recoil
cards.description: Their weapons kick like cannons: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is flung straight back to the square it attacked from (the victim is still taken, but the ground is not). Captures that promote are too heavy to throw back.

cards.name: No Reins
cards.description: Their long pieces bolt: for your opponent's next 4 turns, every bishop, rook or queen slide must run as far as the line allows: to the board's edge, into a capture, or right up against one of their own pieces. No stopping halfway. Knights, pawns and the king keep their footing.

cards.name: Tolling Bell
cards.description: A cracked bell hangs over their army: starting with your opponent's next turn and on every second turn after (their 1st, 3rd and 5th), its toll deafens the long arms: their bishops, rooks and queen cannot move on tolling turns. On the quiet turns in between, everything moves freely. Fades after their 6th turn.

cards.name: War Rations
cards.description: Their war chest is sealed to two requisitions: across your opponent's next 5 turns they may make at most 2 captures. Once both are spent, their army cannot capture at all until the curse ends. They pick which battles are worth the ration.

cards.name: Blood Bond
cards.description: Bind two enemy pieces in a bond of shared pain: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever one of the pair captures anything, the other is frozen for 2 of their turns. They may march the pair around all they like; only fighting with one punishes the other. Trade either away and the bond is cut. Kings cannot be bound.

cards.name: Coronation Tax
cards.description: Their crownings come with a hidden levy: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time they promote a pawn, one of their other pieces (chosen by the curse) is called to the ceremony and frozen for 2 of their turns. The new-crowned piece is untouched; the cost is paid elsewhere in the army. Delay the promotion, or pay the levy knowingly. Kings never attend.

cards.name: Debtor's Mark
cards.description: Mark one enemy piece as a debtor: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every turn they leave it standing idle it runs up one turn of debt (up to 4). The instant they finally move it, the debt comes due and it is frozen for that many of their turns, then the slate is cleared. Moving it every turn keeps the debt at zero; leaving it parked forever costs nothing but a dead piece. Kings keep no debts.

cards.name: Exile's Mark
cards.description: Brand one enemy knight, bishop or rook as an exile: every move it makes must carry it closer to your side of the board, and if it has not set foot in your half within 6 of their turns, it crumbles to dust. The mark lifts the instant it stands in your half. They can march it forward into danger, trade it away, or spend the other pieces while it withers. Kings are never exiled.

cards.name: Jammed Portcullis
cards.description: A hex sits over their castle gate for the next 10 of their turns: if your opponent castles, the portcullis jams behind them. Two of their turns later, the rook that castled grinds to a halt and is frozen for 3 of their turns. It is a delayed, fully visible price on castling; if they never castle, or accept a stranded rook, the curse simply idles. Kings are never frozen.

cards.name: Wandering Sentry
cards.description: Conjure a spectral sentry that paces a rank in your opponent's half: the square it stands on is barred to their pieces, and every turn it steps one file across, turning back when it reaches the edge. It patrols for 5 of their turns, then dissolves. Its beat is fixed and fully visible - time your moves through the gap behind it.

cards.name: I Love Smelling My GF's Hoodie
cards.description: Wrap one of your pieces in the hoodie: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Warm, safe, faintly of her.

cards.name: Iron Bishop
cards.description: One bishop cannot be captured by pawns, for the game.

cards.name: Jet Lag
cards.description: Book your opponent a red-eye: their clock loses 20 seconds, and the next piece they move is left so groggy it must move again on the turn after. If that piece can no longer move, the repeat is skipped.

cards.name: Knight to Nightrook
cards.description: One knight also slides straight up and down its file, any distance, for the game.

cards.name: Lag Spike
cards.description: Their connection chooses violence: your opponent's clock loses 25 seconds.

cards.name: Leaden Crown
cards.description: The crown is too heavy to march: for your opponent's next 4 turns their queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward slides are free.

cards.name: Legendary Forge
cards.description: The forge mends what war broke: one of your captured knights or bishops is reforged and returns to your pocket. Spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Ley Line
cards.description: You wake the old current sleeping under the board: one of your pieces rides it to any empty square on its own file, once.

cards.name: Magnet
cards.description: Drag one enemy piece (not the king) one square toward your king.

cards.name: Momentum
cards.description: After your next capture, immediately take a second move, once.

cards.name: Monkeytype
cards.description: Type at full speed: relocate up to 3 of your pieces, each exactly one square, in a rapid burst of keystrokes. Kings sit this test out.

cards.name: Napping
cards.description: The enemy piece farthest from its own king sneaks a nap while nobody is watching: it is frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings never nap; ties pick the square nearest a1.

cards.name: No Trespass
cards.description: A truce holds at the crossroads: your opponent cannot capture anything standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their next 5 turns.

cards.name: North Star
cards.description: The fixed star steadies your hand: your next draft is fated to offer tier 4 cards.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.description: Your knights move like knights or kings for 3 turns.

cards.name: Overtime Whistle
cards.description: Blow the whistle for overtime: add 30 seconds to your own clock.

cards.name: Pawn Nerf
cards.description: Nerf your opponent's pawns: their two-square double step is removed for the rest of the game. Every enemy pawn crawls one square at a time.

cards.name: Petrified Towers
cards.description: Turn one enemy rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns, and while the tower stands petrified your opponent cannot castle at all.

cards.name: Phalanx
cards.description: Your entire pawn line becomes uncapturable for 2 turns.

cards.name: Piece Parole
cards.description: Release one of your pieces on parole: it gains a lasting shield, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Piece Steal
cards.description: Convert one enemy pawn to your color, once.

cards.name: Pin Breaker
cards.description: One of your pieces breaks free with a knight's leap to an empty square, once.

cards.name: Pixie Dust
cards.description: A handful of glittering dust settles on your stables: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square diagonally.

cards.name: Subscriber Raid
cards.description: A fake donation alert blasts across the board and the raid pours in: add 20 seconds to your clock while your opponent loses 10 to the chaos.

cards.name: Phishing Email
cards.description: You are the prince now: a spoofed email talks your opponent out of their secrets. Reveal their hidden nerf for the rest of the game, and peek at the cards in their next draft offer.

cards.name: Promote Now
cards.description: Instantly promote one of your pawns on your 6th rank or beyond to a queen.

cards.name: Purge Two
cards.description: Remove one enemy pawn, and freeze every other enemy pawn for their next turn.

cards.name: Queen's Echo
cards.description: Your rooks move like queens for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Raise Dead
cards.description: Speak the words of unmaking over enemy soil: one of your fallen pawns, knights, or bishops rises again on an empty square in your OPPONENT'S half of the board, once.

cards.name: Rank Runner
cards.description: One pawn advances to any empty square on its file up to your 5th rank, once.

cards.name: Regenerate
cards.description: Revive two of your captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

cards.name: Rewind One
cards.description: Undo the last two half-moves: send the last piece each side moved back to the square it came from, once.

cards.name: Rook to Chancellor
cards.description: One rook also moves like a knight, for the game.

cards.name: Royal Duty
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn they may move only their king.

cards.name: Rubber Chicken
cards.description: Bonk one enemy piece with a rubber chicken. It is too embarrassed to move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be bonked.

cards.name: Seance
cards.description: The circle trades places with the beyond: send one of your knights or bishops across to the other side, and one of your captured rooks returns in its place, on the square that knight or bishop just vacated.

cards.name: Second Wind Major
cards.description: Return a captured rook to any empty back-rank square, once.

cards.name: Seelie Blessing
cards.description: The bright court smiles on one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Sliding King
cards.description: Your king moves like a king or bishop for 3 turns.

cards.name: Snap Freeze
cards.description: Freeze the piece that last moved for 2 of its turns.

cards.name: Sown Salt
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns are rooted in salted ground and cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Split Bishop
cards.description: Add a new bishop to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Split March
cards.description: Four pawns each advance one square immediately.

cards.name: Spooked Steeds
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their knights for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Stinky
cards.description: One enemy piece other than the king reeks: for your opponent's next 3 turns their other pieces cannot move onto any square adjacent to it. The smelly piece itself may still move anywhere.

cards.name: Summon Knight
cards.description: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, once.

cards.name: Super Glue
cards.description: Empty the tube on one enemy piece: it and every enemy piece orthogonally next to it are stuck fast and cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted or stuck.

cards.name: Supply Drop
cards.description: A knight is airlifted into your reserves, and a crate of spares lands with it as a pawn. Later, spend turns to drop them onto empty squares.

cards.name: Tempo Theft
cards.description: Steal your opponent's next turn (you move twice, they wait), once.

cards.name: Tidal Push
cards.description: Shove one enemy piece two squares in a straight line if the path is empty, once.

cards.name: Time Skip
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the piece they last moved is frozen for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Timely Lull
cards.description: Free action: a lull settles over the whole board: both players' nerfs are suspended for their next 3 turns, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Trampoline
cards.description: Bounce one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square within two squares of it.

cards.name: Trippi Troppi
cards.description: The shrimp-cat scrambles their proprioception: up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king) grow stubby shrimp legs, and for their next 2 turns each can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Twist the Knife
cards.description: Their drawback bites back: for your opponent's next 3 captures, the capturing piece is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Underdog's Grit
cards.description: While you have fewer pieces than your opponent, your nerf is suspended.

cards.name: Understaffed
cards.description: Half the office calls in sick: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece standing on files a through d.

cards.name: Vanguard
cards.description: One pawn on your 6th rank or beyond promotes to a knight, once.

cards.name: Arcane Reroll
cards.description: Gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Banish
cards.description: Banish one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop from the board, once.

cards.name: Blink
cards.description: Your king blinks: it trades places with one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, once.

cards.name: Conjured Scout
cards.description: Conjure a knight on an empty square on your back rank. It fights for 2 of your turns, then fades.

cards.name: Foresight
cards.description: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your next draft rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Ghostwalk
cards.description: One of your bishops may also step one square straight, like a rook, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Sigil Ward
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to move up next to it in that time is frozen for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Spectral Retinue
cards.description: Your retinue turns spectral and re-forms: every one of your knights becomes a bishop, and every one of your bishops becomes a knight, where they stand.

cards.name: Phase Field
cards.description: One of your bishops slips half out of the world: each move it may pass through a single piece of either color, for the game. It still cannot capture its own side.

cards.name: Suppress Magic
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft offer contains no draft-manipulation cards, and the next buff they draft arrives nullified.

cards.name: Transmute
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns into a knight, once.

cards.name: Wall
cards.description: Raise a wall on one empty square you pick: enemy pieces can never move onto it, for the game.

cards.name: Warp Home
cards.description: Teleport one of your pieces back to a vacant starting square of its own type, once. A rook warps to an empty a1 or h1, a knight to b1 or g1, a pawn to any open square on its second rank, and so on.

cards.name: Warp Step
cards.description: Move one piece up to three squares in a straight line to an empty square, passing over any pieces in between, once. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Wasted Hour
cards.description: The officers argue all morning: on your opponent's next turn they may only move a pawn or their king.

cards.name: Backseat Driver
cards.description: Someone will not stop yelling push a pawn: on your opponent's next turn they must move a pawn if any pawn of theirs can legally move.

cards.name: Black Hole
cards.description: Open a black hole on one empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it, never a king, is swallowed off the board. It stays open for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Clumsy Dash
cards.description: Bolt for it and fumble: take one extra move right now, but one of your pawns is dropped and frozen in place for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Moonwalk
cards.description: Teach your pawns to moonwalk: for your next 3 turns each of your pawns may also step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Red Tape
cards.description: Bury your opponent in paperwork: they skip their next turn, but the forms catch up with you and you skip the turn after that.

cards.name: Sacrificial Bishop
cards.description: Feed one of your bishops to the volcano to smite one enemy knight or bishop you name: both leave the board, once.

cards.name: Slip on Ice
cards.description: Freeze one of your opponent's rooks in place for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Stage Fright
cards.description: The spotlight waits for her: the next time your opponent's queen moves, stage fright strikes and she freezes where she lands for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Ball Lightning
cards.description: Your next 2 captures each also destroy the enemy pieces (never a king) on the two squares immediately left and right of the captured square.

cards.name: Bramble Wall
cards.description: Thorns snare the clergy: your opponent's bishops cannot move or capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Creeping Roots
cards.description: Roots grip at the border: your opponent's pawns cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Gale
cards.description: A driving wind opens gaps: for your next 2 turns your bishops may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

cards.name: River Flow
cards.description: The board runs like water: for your next 2 turns your rooks may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

cards.name: Seedlings
cards.description: Plant two seeds on empty squares in your half: after 3 of your turns, a pawn sprouts on each square that is still empty.

cards.name: Static Field
cards.description: Static builds on anything that runs: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that travels 3 or more squares in one move is grounded, frozen for 1 turn where it lands.

cards.name: Stone Grip
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece (never a king) to a walnut for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. The enemy pieces directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Whirlpool
cards.description: A whirlpool drags one enemy pawn to your side and deposits it on your 4th rank, yours now and ready to advance.

cards.name: Will-o'-Wisp
cards.description: A cold flame dances ahead of one enemy piece and it follows: lure one enemy piece except a king one square diagonally forward, toward your side, onto an empty square you choose.

cards.name: Dragoons
cards.description: One of your knights trains to vault the line: it may also jump exactly two squares straight in any direction, over anything, for the game.

cards.name: Flank March
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, each of your bishops may also step one square straight in any direction.

cards.name: Forced Retreat
cards.description: Push one enemy piece one square directly away from your king, if that square is empty, once. Kings cannot be pushed.

cards.name: Phalanx Advance
cards.description: Shields lock across the whole front: enemy pawns can never capture your pawns, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Pontoon Bridge
cards.description: One of your rooks, bishops, or queens may pass through up to two of your own pieces on its move, once.

cards.name: Sapper Team
cards.description: The sappers surface behind their lines: place a new pawn on an empty square in your opponent's half of the board.

cards.name: War Wagon
cards.description: One of your bishops may also move up to two squares straight in any direction, for the game.

cards.name: Abandoned Post
cards.description: Nobody presses the attack: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any move toward your side of the board may cover at most 2 squares. Sideways moves and retreats keep their full range.

cards.name: Adrenaline
cards.description: Whenever your king is in check, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Amazon Knight
cards.description: One knight becomes a knight plus queen for 2 turns.

cards.name: Army Reversal
cards.description: For your next 2 turns, each of your pawns may also move one square straight backward onto an empty square (no capture).

cards.name: Atomic Captures (Small)
cards.description: Your captures clear enemy pieces on the two squares beside the captured piece.

cards.name: Ballerina Cappuccina
cards.description: The coffee-cup ballerina leads a formation twirl: choose one of your pieces (not the king) to step one square, then up to two allies that stood beside it may each step one square too. No captures, just choreography.

cards.name: Battle Pass
cards.description: Season rewards trickle in: at the end of each of your next 6 turns, your clock gains 10 seconds.

cards.name: Bear Trap
cards.description: Hide a bear trap on an empty square, visible only in your nightmares: the first enemy piece except a king to step onto it is snapped up and cannot move for 4 of their turns.

cards.name: Blink Army
cards.description: Teleport two pawns forward two squares each if empty, once.

cards.name: Blockade
cards.description: Wall the enemy front: their pawns cannot advance or capture for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Buff Thief (Minor)
cards.description: Steal one tier 1 or 2 buff from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Buzzer Beater
cards.description: Steal a buzzer-beating 20 seconds off your opponent's clock and put it on yours.

cards.name: Cornered King
cards.description: Desperation teaches strange footwork: while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your king may also move like a knight. Lasts the rest of the game.

cards.name: Masquerade
cards.description: Two of your pieces trade masks: choose two of your knights, bishops, rooks or queens of different kinds, and they swap types where they stand. Your material never changes, only where the powers live.

cards.name: Queen's Testament
cards.description: Her will is already written: the first time your opponent captures your queen, up to two of your captured knights and bishops immediately return to empty squares nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Spoils of War
cards.description: The finest piece you have captured from your opponent defects to your colors: place it on an empty square on your home rank. It leaves your opponent's revival pool for good. Queens defect first, then rooks, bishops, knights, pawns.

cards.name: Battlefield Commission
cards.description: The deeper the hole, the higher the field promotion: if you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your most advanced pawn is promoted where it stands - to a knight, or to a rook if you are outnumbered by four pieces or more. Used while you are not behind, the commission goes unsigned.

cards.name: Coronation Bonus
cards.description: The crowning is worth a stolen hour: the first time one of your pawns promotes, you gain 30 seconds on your clock. In untimed games it grants nothing.

cards.name: Eleventh Hour
cards.description: When the last of the line is nearly spent, help arrives: the first time your non-king pieces number three or fewer, your best captured piece returns to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: King's Road
cards.description: One lane on the board is declared yours: choose a file, and for the rest of the game no enemy piece may stand on that file within your own half of the board. Your pieces travel it freely.

cards.name: Plunderer's Ledger
cards.description: Every prize is entered in the ledger: each of your next 3 captures earns you one draft reroll to spend whenever you like.

cards.name: Royal Caper
cards.description: A cornered king learns to vault: while your king is in check it may leap like a knight. The trick works twice, then the old bones remember their age.

cards.name: Cascade Freeze
cards.description: For 3 turns, each capture you make freezes the nearest enemy piece 1 turn.

cards.name: Chain Nullify
cards.description: Cancel the next buff your opponent drafts before use.

cards.name: Changeling
cards.description: The cradle swap ran the other way: one enemy knight or bishop you choose was a changeling all along. The glamour breaks and it is just a pawn.

cards.name: Coffee
cards.description: Knock it back: take two extra moves right now, but the jitters hand your opponent one extra move on their reply.

cards.name: Comet Shard
cards.description: A shard of a passing comet crashes onto the board as a bishop: place it on any empty square in your half. It lands still glowing and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Computer Virus
cards.description: Upload a virus to your opponent's clock. At the end of each of their next 5 turns it drains 8 seconds from their time. The clock floor still stops it from flagging them instantly.

cards.name: Counter-Nerf
cards.description: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Cryostasis
cards.description: Flash-freeze one enemy piece you target: it and every enemy piece beside it are frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings are never frozen.

cards.name: Let It Ride
cards.description: Flip a coin and let your winnings ride. Each heads bumps the prize and flips again, up to three. One heads pays 40 seconds. Two heads pays a knight in your pocket. Three heads pays a knight and a bishop plus 20 seconds. Tails on the first flip loses the ante, your weakest pawn.

cards.name: Daniel Caesar
cards.description: Smooth things over. For your opponent's next 3 turns none of their pieces may capture anything, so the board stays calm while you set up.

cards.name: Day One Patch
cards.description: The devs buffed pawns, but only in YOUR build: for your next 2 turns your pawns may also step one square diagonally forward onto empty squares (never onto the last rank).

cards.name: Dead Letter
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, but they gain one reroll in return.

cards.name: Deadline
cards.description: Every deliverable now costs overtime: your opponent's next 3 captures each cost them 15 seconds off the clock.

cards.name: Detonate
cards.description: Sacrifice one pawn to clear all pieces on its adjacent squares except kings.

cards.name: Direwolf Pack
cards.description: Two spectral direwolves answer your howl: place two knights on empty squares in your half. The pack melts back into the mist after 5 of your turns.

cards.name: Double or Nothing
cards.description: Bet one of your other held cards on a coin flip. Heads: it is upgraded two tiers. Tails: it is knocked down one tier, but you keep it.

cards.name: Duelist
cards.description: One piece survives the first capture against it and the attacker dies instead, once (kings excluded).

cards.name: Extra Move
cards.description: Take two moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Faerie Ring
cards.description: A ring of pale mushrooms springs up around a square you choose: the 8 squares surrounding it are impassable to your opponent for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Fan Club
cards.description: The home crowd guards your bench: while you have as many or more pieces as your opponent, your pawns on your back three ranks cannot be captured. Fall behind on material and the cheering stops.

cards.name: Fault Line
cards.description: Split the board; enemy pieces cannot cross one file you pick, for 2 turns.

cards.name: Firecracker
cards.description: Startle one enemy piece (not the king): it retreats one square toward its home rank.

cards.name: Fissure Field
cards.description: The ground splits open behind the enemy army: your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own back rank for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Flypaper File
cards.description: Coat one file in flypaper, visible to both players: for your next 6 turns, enemy pieces (kings excepted) that enter that file are stuck and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Forearm Veins
cards.description: Veins run dead straight up the forearm: for the game, each of your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of it, one square straight forward.

cards.name: Frozen Furrows
cards.description: The ruts freeze over between hauls: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever they move a rook, their rooks cannot move at all on their following turn.

cards.name: Gamble
cards.description: Flip a fair coin, heads half the time. Heads: for your next two draft offers you take every card instead of one, and your next offer rolls a tier higher. Tails: both you and your opponent skip your next draft, but your following offer still rolls a tier higher.

cards.name: Giant Slayer
cards.description: Your pawns carry slings and know the soft spots: twice this game, one of your pawns may capture an enemy piece on any square directly beside it.

cards.name: Grand Recall
cards.description: Return your queen (if on board) to any empty square in your half, once.

cards.name: Granite Towers
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Greenhouse
cards.description: Raise a glass dome over one file. For the game, your pawns may promote one rank early, on your 7th rank instead of your 8th, when they advance along that file, capture out of it, or capture into it.

cards.name: Hard Frost
cards.description: Freeze two enemy pieces you target so they cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Heavy Shackles
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their queen or their rooks for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Hero's Journey
cards.description: The call to adventure rings out: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, and your bank offer improves by one tier.

cards.name: Hex Doll
cards.description: You bind a lock of horsehair to a little cloth doll: choose one enemy piece except a king. If it captures anything within their next 3 turns, the pin goes in and it is destroyed.

cards.name: Hold the Bridge
cards.description: One hero plants their feet: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks. It cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, but it stands its ground and cannot move for those turns either.

cards.name: Hot Potato
cards.description: Curse one enemy piece other than the king into a hot potato: for their next 4 turns your opponent must move that piece if it has any legal move.

cards.name: Compounding Misery
cards.description: Misery multiplies: freeze one enemy piece you target for 1 of their turns, plus 1 more turn for every other curse-effect already afflicting your opponent (each frozen or petrified piece, sealed ground, or royal edict), up to 4 turns total. Cast onto a clean board it is a small chill; stacked on other hexes it bites deep. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Twinned Torment
cards.description: Stitch two enemy pieces into one fate: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever one of the bound pair moves, the other seizes up and is frozen for 1 turn. They can still use one of the two freely, but only by leaving its twin nailed down. A captured twin slips the bond and frees the other. Kings cannot be bound.

cards.name: Weight of Toil
cards.description: The curse counts every errand: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any single piece that makes its third move in that time collapses under the toil and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns (shuffling one square at a time). Spreading the work across the army avoids it entirely. Kings never collapse.

cards.name: The Witching Hour
cards.description: Midnight creeps up on their army: for your opponent's next 4 turns, every piece they move is touched by the hour. When midnight strikes at the end of those 4 turns, all touched pieces freeze for 2 of their turns. Moving few pieces, or only ones they can spare, keeps the damage down.

cards.name: Aging Blade
cards.description: Every kill costs them a little youth: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever a queen, rook or bishop captures, it ages one rank on the spot - a queen becomes a rook, a rook a bishop, a bishop a knight. Knights and pawns are already too humble to age, so trading with them is safe. Capturing with their heavy pieces slowly grinds the army down.

cards.name: Miasma
cards.description: A sickly fog settles over their ranks: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time they move a piece so it ends adjacent to another of their pieces, that piece breathes in the miasma and grows more sick. On its third breath it succumbs and is frozen for 2 of their turns, and its lungs clear again. Keeping their pieces spread apart is the whole cure. Kings do not sicken.

cards.name: Mutiny
cards.description: Sow mutiny in the cavalry: for your opponent's next 6 turns, the first time one of their knights captures a piece, it turns its coat on the spot and fights for you for your next 3 turns, then rides back to them. They can deny it by capturing with anything but a knight, or by keeping their knights out of the fray. If it is captured while it serves you, the mutiny simply ends.

cards.name: Forced Pilgrimage
cards.description: Lay a geas on one enemy piece and name a shrine square it must reach: if that piece stands on the shrine within 6 of their turns, the geas lifts. If the deadline passes and it has not, the piece collapses in exhaustion and is frozen for 3 of their turns. Its other pieces are free; the victim can walk the pilgrim to the shrine, trade it, or let it fall. Kings take no geas.

cards.name: Sinking Mire
cards.description: Conjure a sucking mire in your opponent's half: a cross of five squares no enemy piece may step onto (pieces caught inside may still climb out). Unlike a spreading rot the mire drains away, losing one arm of the cross on each of their turns until nothing is left, over 5 of their turns. Route around the puddle and wait it out, or fight past its edge.

cards.name: Powder Keg
cards.description: Roll a powder keg onto an empty square in your opponent's half with a lit 4-turn fuse, in full view. When the fuse burns out, it detonates: every enemy piece (except the king) standing on or next to that square is blown off the board. The count is on the card the whole time - clear their pieces out of the blast before it goes, or lose whatever lingers.

cards.name: I Love Abs
cards.description: Brace your core. Every one of your pieces standing in the central 16 squares becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Immobilizer
cards.description: One piece freezes all adjacent enemy pieces except kings while it stands there.

cards.name: Insurance
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, a new knight appears on your queen's starting square (d1 for White, d8 for Black), or on the nearest empty square of that rank if her home is taken. Triggers once.

cards.name: Iron Wall
cards.description: Every piece on your back rank, your king aside, is uncapturable for 2 turns.

cards.name: Ironbound Rook
cards.description: Bind one enemy rook to its rank: for 4 of their turns it cannot leave the rank it stands on. It may still slide sideways.

cards.name: King of the Hill
cards.description: Your king rules the hill: while it stands on or beside one of the four center squares it may move like a queen.

cards.name: Kingslide
cards.description: Your king moves any distance in a straight line, once.

cards.name: Lirili Larila
cards.description: The cactus-elephant trades your afternoon for its hourglass: steal 45 seconds from your opponent's clock, but you skip your own next turn.

cards.name: Lost Weekend
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and their clock loses 20 seconds.

cards.name: Mass Freeze
cards.description: Freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 full turn.

cards.name: Mass Recall
cards.description: Return any two pieces to your back rank, once.

cards.name: Medusa's Stare
cards.description: Turn one enemy queen you target into a walnut for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.description: Force a violent change of form on one of your own pawns, knights, or bishops: it reshapes itself into a rook, once.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.description: Copy one random unspent buff your opponent holds. Locked-in upgrades cannot be copied.

cards.name: Moai Head
cards.description: A stone moai drops onto an empty square of your choice and just... stands there: for the next 4 turns of each side, NO piece from either side may move onto that square. Then it crumbles. It offers no further comment. 🗿

cards.name: Muscle Up
cards.description: Explosive pull-up: take one of your pieces except the king and hurl it straight up its own file to any empty square, blurring past everything in the way. Once.

cards.name: Mute Button
cards.description: You mute the loudest voices in their army: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks cannot capture.

cards.name: Mystery Box
cards.description: Rattle the crate and pop the lid: your next draft offer rolls at a completely random tier, anywhere from 2 to 7.

cards.name: Opposite Day
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot move any piece closer to your king. Moves that keep the same distance are allowed. If that would leave them with no legal move, the restriction is lifted for that turn.

cards.name: Origami
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks are folded into paper cranes: they may move at most 1 square for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Overrun
cards.description: Your pawns can capture straight ahead on your next turn.

cards.name: Overtime Pay
cards.description: You clock in and cash out on the spot: 105 seconds go straight onto your own clock the moment you play this. Time and a half, paid in full.

cards.name: Patch Notes
cards.description: The balance patch lands: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and you gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Phantom Guardian
cards.description: Call up a phantom guardian that fights beside you as a bishop for 5 of your turns, then dissolves back into the aether.

cards.name: Phantom Rook
cards.description: Spawn a rook that vanishes after 4 turns, on any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Photosynthesis
cards.description: Your pawns grow toward the light: after every 3 of your turns, one of your pawns advances one square on its own (the pawn nearest promotion that has an empty square ahead). It never auto-advances onto the promotion rank.

cards.name: Pinocchio
cards.description: One pawn's nose grows: each of your turns it does not capture, its reach grows by one square, up to plus four. It may capture the first enemy piece other than a king directly ahead of it within that reach. Capturing shrinks the nose back to zero.

cards.name: Pizza Delivery
cards.description: The delivery scooter double-parks and the boxes pile up: choose three empty squares; your opponent's pieces cannot move onto them for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Pop-up Ad
cards.description: An ad nobody can close appears on the board: place a knight on any empty square. It is finally dismissed after 4 of your turns.

cards.name: Blue Screen of Death
cards.description: Their whole board bluescreens and reboots: collecting error info, then a slow restart. Your opponent's clock loses 35 seconds.

cards.name: Captcha Check
cards.description: Select all squares with a bicycle to continue. Verification fails: whichever piece type your opponent has moved the most is locked and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: NerfChess Defender
cards.description: Threat detected. A fake antivirus sweeps their board and quarantines up to 2 random enemy pieces: they cannot move for 2 of your opponent's turns. Kings are too big to quarantine.

cards.name: Forced Update
cards.description: Installing update 1 of 3, do not turn off your opponent. A progress bar crawls: at the end of each of their next 3 turns their clock loses 8 seconds.

cards.name: Pop-up Storm
cards.description: HOT DEALS raining on their side: plant 2 pop-up windows on empty squares in your opponent's half. For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that clicks onto one (a king is too careful to) is closed out of the game.

cards.name: Ratio'd
cards.description: Nobody asked, plus you fell off: if your opponent captured a piece on their last turn, that piece gets bonked straight back toward its own side by up to 2 squares.

cards.name: Puck's Mischief
cards.description: A hobgoblin ties every royal shoelace together: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Recast
cards.description: Gain an extra draft reroll, and your next draft rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.description: Return your advanced pawns to their starting rank where empty, once.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.description: Two pawns march in from the depot right now: place them on empty squares of your back two ranks.

cards.name: Respite
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns.

cards.name: Resurrect
cards.description: Bring back your strongest captured piece to your half, once.

cards.name: Resurrect Major
cards.description: Revive a captured rook or bishop to any empty square, once.

cards.name: RGB Keyboard
cards.description: Light up every key. For the game your knights add a 1-square step any direction, your bishops slide 2 straight, and your rooks slide 2 diagonally.

cards.name: Royal Decree
cards.description: Your king gains queen movement for 2 turns (still loses on capture).

cards.name: Scout
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft instead of one, but spend one of your rerolls.

cards.name: Sea Monkeys
cards.description: Just add water: four tiny pawns hatch on random empty squares in your half and grow into real pawns.

cards.name: Sealed Gate
cards.description: Brick up one gate of your choosing: pick any square, and your opponent cannot move any piece onto that square's entire file for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Second Army
cards.description: Add two pawns to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Serpent Brood
cards.description: Venomous stone serpents coil around the enemy clergy: every one of your opponent's bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the venom lingers so no enemy bishop may capture for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Shackle the Queen
cards.description: Bind the enemy queen in cursed iron: your opponent cannot move their queen for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Shieldmaiden
cards.description: A shieldmaiden plants herself before one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Skill Issue
cards.description: Diagnosis delivered: their minor pieces whiff every attack: enemy knights and bishops cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Snooze Button
cards.description: Pump sleeping gas down one file you pick: every enemy piece except the king standing on that file falls asleep and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Solstice
cards.description: The longest day gives everyone one more step: for your next turn, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Staff of Stasis
cards.description: Bind the staff to one of your pieces: whoever dares capture it is locked in a bubble of frozen time for 3 of their turns. The ward lasts the rest of the game.

cards.name: Statue Stable
cards.description: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and your own knights harden into living statues: they cannot be captured for those same 2 turns.

cards.name: Stone Clergy
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Sugar Rush
cards.description: Slam a sugar rush: take three extra moves right now. Then comes the sugar crash and you skip your next turn.

cards.name: Suppress
cards.description: Your opponent cannot draft manipulation buffs next draft.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.description: You deal your opponent the worst card in the deck: name one enemy rook and it crumbles to rubble where it stands.

cards.name: Total Recall
cards.description: Pull each of your pieces past your 4th rank back to your 3rd rank where empty, once.

cards.name: Touch Grass
cards.description: You step outside for your own good: add 30 seconds to your clock, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Tralalero Tralala
cards.description: The shark in sneakers sprints: dash any piece except the king to an empty square along its rank, file, or diagonal, blurring straight past anything between. It moves so fast it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Once.

cards.name: Trapdoor
cards.description: Rig a spring on an empty square. For your next 4 turns, an enemy piece except a king that steps onto it is flung one square back toward its home rank and cannot move for 1 of their turns. A slapstick trap, not a delete.

cards.name: Twin Knights
cards.description: Both knights become nightrooks, for the game.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.description: The whole room tilts sideways: for their next 2 turns your opponent may only make diagonal moves. Their king keeps its footing and may still step anywhere.

cards.name: Arcane Conduit
cards.description: One of your rooks may also move up to two squares diagonally for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Bind the Queen
cards.description: Arcane chains seize the enemy queen and every piece standing next to her: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Borrowed Minute
cards.description: Borrow one enemy knight for a minute: it fights for you for your next 2 turns, then walks back to their side. If it dies meanwhile, the loan is settled.

cards.name: Camel Rider
cards.description: All your knights also make a longer 3-by-1 camel leap for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Chrono Siphon
cards.description: Steal up to 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and freeze one enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Conjured Bishop
cards.description: Conjure your bishop's reflection: choose one of your bishops whose mirror square (same rank, file flipped left-to-right) is empty, and a new bishop appears there.

cards.name: Disjunction
cards.description: The conjuration is disjoined: up to two pieces waiting in your opponent's pocket wink out of existence, strongest first.

cards.name: Disrupt Ritual
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, and your next draft offer shows three cards instead of two.

cards.name: Dominate
cards.description: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop for your next 3 turns. When the time is up it reverts to your opponent.

cards.name: Far Step
cards.description: Teleport one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square on the board, once.

cards.name: Glyph Seal
cards.description: Seal one file: pick any square and its whole file becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns, and every enemy piece already standing on it is bound in place for its next 2 turns.
