cards.name: High Roll
cards.description: Force your next draft offer to roll at tier 5.

cards.name: Jinx
cards.description: The jinx sours every friendship: for their next 2 turns, your opponent's pieces cannot end a move on a square beside another of their own pieces.

cards.name: Mind Read
cards.description: Your opponent's next drafted buff arrives nullified, and their reroll token slips away if they hold one.

cards.name: Omniscience
cards.description: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game; your next draft shows three cards to pick from.

cards.name: Quicken
cards.description: Time reasserts itself around your army: every freeze, stasis, and walnut afflicting YOUR pieces is dispelled on the spot.

cards.name: Stone the Pawns
cards.description: Turn every one of your opponent's pawns to stone for their next 3 turns: each may only shuffle one square at a time and cannot break into a full stride.

cards.name: Fold Space
cards.description: Swap the squares of up to two pairs of your own pieces, once.

cards.name: Time Stop
cards.description: Stop one piece in time, yours or theirs (never a king): for 2 of its owner's turns it cannot move, and it cannot be captured. It is simply not here right now.

cards.name: Void Rift
cards.description: Tear a permanent rift on an empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it (never a king) is pulled out of the game, and any enemy piece that ends its move on a square next to the rift is frozen for its next turn.

cards.name: Warding Circle
cards.description: You chalk a circle of old names around your throne: no enemy piece may end its move on any of the squares around your king, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Warp Field
cards.description: Move any two of your pieces one square each ignoring rules, once.

cards.name: Warp Reign
cards.description: Swap the positions of your king and queen and shield both for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Warp Rook
cards.description: One rook teleports to any empty square on the board, once.

cards.name: Watermelon Rind
cards.description: Duck behind the rind: every one of your pieces standing on your back two ranks cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pieces further forward are outside the shell.

cards.name: Banana Peel Trail
cards.description: Grease one file with banana peels: pieces may still enter it, but the first enemy piece to do so slips one square back toward its own home rank and is too dazed to move on its next turn.

cards.name: Body Double
cards.description: Slip one of your opponent's knights or bishops a better offer: it switches to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

cards.name: Butterfingers
cards.description: Your whole army is slathered in butter: enemy pawns and knights cannot capture your pieces for their next 2 turns. Nothing short-armed can keep a grip.

cards.name: Chaos Reigns
cards.description: Fairness goes out the window: take two extra moves right now, but your opponent also takes two extra moves on their next turn.

cards.name: Lost and Found
cards.description: Dig through the lost and found: return one of your captured pieces other than the queen to an empty square in your half, once. The heaviest lost piece comes back first.

cards.name: Panic Button
cards.description: Slam the big red button: your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, and you take one extra move right now to sort out the mess.

cards.name: Pinata
cards.description: Swing wildly and hope: one random enemy piece other than the king is knocked off the board, but one of your own pawns bursts in the mess and is lost too.

cards.name: Quicksand Patch
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's pawns sinks into quicksand and can only crawl one square at a time for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Tar Pit
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's bishops is stuck fast and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Yeet
cards.description: Wind up and launch one of your own pieces deep into enemy territory: send it to any empty square in your opponent's half, once. Your king stays put.

cards.name: Ancient Grove
cards.description: Old roots give one piece back: return a captured rook, knight, or bishop to an empty square on your back rank, once.

cards.name: Backdraft
cards.description: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, every enemy piece other than a pawn or king on the squares around it is destroyed.

cards.name: Glaciate
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece (never a king) for 3 of their turns, and the frost spreads: every enemy piece directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Hailstorm
cards.description: Freeze every one of your opponent's pawns for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.description: One queen looses a bolt down a diagonal, removing the first enemy piece it hits (never a king) and landing beyond it, once.

cards.name: Riptide
cards.description: A countercurrent runs through the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on the 4th or 5th rank is dragged one square back toward its home rank, when that square is free.

cards.name: Stone Soldiers
cards.description: One of your pawns is carved into a stone soldier: it cannot move and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, then the stone crumbles and it wakes.

cards.name: Thunderhead
cards.description: A charged cloud takes shape as a knight on an empty square in your half, and its arrival blasts one enemy pawn standing beside it off the board. It fights for 3 of your turns, then rolls away.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.description: A current sweeps one of your pieces to any empty square, then drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward where it lands.

cards.name: Verdant Shield
cards.description: A canopy of bark: all of your pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Any enemy pawn directly in front of one of your pawns is rooted and cannot move for 1 turn.

cards.name: White Monster
cards.description: Crack the can: take 2 extra moves right now for a triple-move turn. Then the sugar crash hits and you skip your next turn. Once.

cards.name: Bayonet Charge
cards.description: One of your bishops charges diagonally, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and landing just beyond, once.

cards.name: Bombardment
cards.description: Remove two enemy pawns you name from the board, once.

cards.name: Command Tent
cards.description: Your king may also move like a knight, for the game.

cards.name: Counter Charge
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is frozen in place for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Defectors
cards.description: Turn one enemy pawn or knight to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

cards.name: Field Fortification
cards.description: Your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of them, for the game.

cards.name: Flanking Knights
cards.description: Both of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king, for the game.

cards.name: Forward Observer
cards.description: The observer calls in indirect fire: for your next 2 turns, your rooks may capture an enemy piece along a rank or file even when exactly one piece stands in the way. The blocker is unharmed; the rook lands on its target.

cards.name: Last Reserves
cards.description: Commit everything: up to two of your captured knights or bishops return to empty squares on your back rank, once.

cards.name: Outriders
cards.description: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, then advance one of your pawns one square.

cards.name: Recommission
cards.description: Return one of your captured rooks to an empty square on your back rank. For the rest of the game the refitted rook may pass through one friendly piece on each move.

cards.name: Reserve Cavalry
cards.description: The reserve waits for the line to break: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a knight rides in on the empty back-rank square nearest your king's file.

cards.name: Shieldbearers
cards.description: While at least one of your pawns stands on a square beside your king, your king cannot be captured, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Suppressive Fire
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's knights is pinned down for their next 2 turns, and so is every enemy pawn standing directly beside one.

cards.name: Wyvern's Dive
cards.description: A wyvern folds its wings and dives: one of your knights streaks in a straight line, snatches up to the first two enemy pieces it reaches, and lands just beyond, once.

cards.name: Zodiac Wheel
cards.description: You read all twelve houses at once: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, all fated to tier 4.

cards.name: Abyss
cards.description: Two squares you pick swallow any enemy piece except a king that enters, for the game.

cards.name: Alt+F4
cards.description: Their whole client crashes to desktop and takes a minute to reboot: your opponent's clock loses 60 seconds.

cards.name: Annihilate
cards.description: Remove one enemy piece below the queen, and freeze every enemy piece orthogonally beside it for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Apotheosis
cards.description: Raise one of your knights, bishops, or rooks to godhood: it leaves the board for a higher plane, and a queen joins your pocket to descend in its place on a later turn.

cards.name: Atomic Captures
cards.description: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece on the 8 squares around the captured square is also removed, except kings and pawns. Lasts the whole game.

cards.name: Ball and Chain
cards.description: Their drawback grows teeth: for your opponent's next 5 turns, the piece they just moved must rest a turn before moving again.

cards.name: Bee Swarm Simulator
cards.description: Release the hive: drop 3 bee pawns on empty squares of the two center ranks, a buzzing swarm that harasses both armies from no-mans-land.

cards.name: Bombombini Gusini
cards.description: The bomber-goose lobs a stun grenade on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Nobody is removed.

cards.name: Borrowed Time
cards.description: Your queen becomes uncapturable for your next 4 moves, and then her time runs out: she is removed from the board.

cards.name: Buff Thief
cards.description: Steal one active buff of any tier from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Burned Dispatches
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and the draft after that arrives nullified and inert.

cards.name: Blood Duel
cards.description: Call a duel of equals: choose one enemy knight, bishop or rook, then one of your own pieces of the same kind. Both are removed from the board. Both losses are real and feed both revival pools.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.description: The deck feeds on sacrifice: destroy one of your own pieces (your king excepted), and your next draft is fated to offer tier 6 cards.

cards.name: Deathless Oath
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) swears the oath: the first time it is captured, it instantly returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. One rebirth, then the oath is spent.

cards.name: Diplomatic Immunity
cards.description: Appoint one of your pieces (your king excepted) as an envoy: it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half of the board, for the rest of the game. In your own half it is fair game.

cards.name: Deep Position
cards.description: Break into their camp and the clock rewards the incursion: the first time any of your pieces reaches your opponent's back two ranks, you gain 45 seconds. In untimed games it grants nothing.

cards.name: Hallowed Ground
cards.description: Consecrate one empty square in your half: no enemy piece may ever stand on it, and while your king is in check it may step there from anywhere on the board.

cards.name: Ironwright's Bargain
cards.description: The forge takes iron and gives iron back heavier: one of your knights or bishops is reforged into a rook, and in payment one of your pawns is thrown into the fire and lost.

cards.name: Martyr's Gift
cards.description: Every loss leaves you something: each of the next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, you gain a draft reroll and 5 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Tunnelers
cards.description: It digs its own lines: choose one of your rooks, and for the rest of the game it may slide straight through your own pieces (never capturing them) to any empty square beyond.

cards.name: Watchword
cards.description: A pawn's protection is absolute: any of your pieces (your king aside) that is defended by one of your pawns cannot be captured. Remove the pawn and the shelter goes with it.

cards.name: Cast a Nerf
cards.description: Cast a nerf on your opponent: they cannot capture for their next 2 turns, and their next drafted card arrives nullified.

cards.name: Cavalry Charge
cards.description: Charge a knight straight along a rank or file: it smashes the first two enemy pieces it hits (never kings), then rolls on to the far side of them, stopping before the next piece or the edge. Its landing shock shoves every enemy a knight's leap away one square back toward home. A friendly piece or enemy king stops the charge. Once.

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.description: One bishop captures up to three enemy pieces down a diagonal and lands beyond them; the bolt then jumps on to freeze the next enemy piece further along that diagonal for 2 of their turns, once.

cards.name: Chains of Binding
cards.description: A spectral chain shackles the enemy's rooks to each other: while both live, neither rook may end a move more than 3 squares from the other, for your opponent's next 5 turns. A lone rook drags its broken chain and moves freely.

cards.name: Checkmate Immunity
cards.description: The first time your king is checked, it cannot be captured on the following turn, once.

cards.name: Collapse
cards.description: Pull every enemy piece except the king one square toward their back rank across the whole board, once.

cards.name: Roulette Wheel
cards.description: You put it all on red and the croupier spins. Land red for a knight in your pocket and 30 seconds. Land black and you lose your weakest piece. Land the green zero and the house cleans you out: lose your weakest piece and your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Slot Machine
cards.description: Pull the arm and watch three reels spin. Match all three symbols for the jackpot: a rook and a knight drop into your pocket to place later, plus 45 seconds. Match two for a knight in your pocket. Match none and the machine eats your weakest piece.

cards.name: Curse of Frailty
cards.description: A wasting curse saps the enemy's strength: for their next 3 turns your opponent cannot capture, and no piece of theirs may slide more than two squares.

cards.name: Danielle
cards.description: Sunshine: grow three new pawns on any empty squares in your own half, basking in a warmth that keeps each of them uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to strike at your king in that time is hurled clean off the board. Kings are never banished.

cards.name: Divine Reckoning
cards.description: The verdict is exile: choose one enemy piece except the king. If one of its own starting squares is free it is sent back there (nearest the a-file first); either way it is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Doom March
cards.description: The march ends where it stands: enemy pieces that have crossed into your half of the board are gripped by dread and cannot move, for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Double Queen
cards.description: Promote any pawn to a queen instantly, even mid-board.

cards.name: Draft Domination
cards.description: Force your opponent's next draft down to tier 2, so both cards they are offered come from a weak tier.

cards.name: Dragon Form
cards.description: One of your rooks unfurls a pair of dragon wings: for the game it also moves diagonally, ranging the board like a queen.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.description: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in a single move, once.

cards.name: Dryad Grove
cards.description: The grove parts for the clergy: your bishops may slide through your own pawns (never capturing them), for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Excalibur
cards.description: One of your bishops also moves like a rook for the game, giving it full queen movement.

cards.name: Expansion Permit
cards.description: The construction crew bolts a ninth file onto the board: for your next 4 turns your rooks and queens may slide off one side of the board and back on the other.

cards.name: Extra Move (Repeat)
cards.description: Take two moves in a row every turn for 2 full turns. You cannot capture the king on the bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Favorable Stars
cards.description: You cast your chart and the houses agree: your next draft is fated to offer tier 5 cards.

cards.name: Fey Step
cards.description: One of your knights or bishops slips into the hedgerow and steps out behind their lines: move it to any empty square on your opponent's back two ranks, once.

cards.name: Frigo Camelo
cards.description: The fridge-camel opens both doors: two of your pieces (never the king) are refrigerated: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but each is frozen solid for 1 of your turns while it defrosts.

cards.name: Frost Wall
cards.description: A wall of blue ice seals the keep: your opponent cannot move any piece onto your back two ranks for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Frozen Moment
cards.description: The next piece your opponent moves freezes solid the instant it lands and cannot move again for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Fur Elise
cards.description: Run your fingers down the keys. Choose a bishop and glide it along one diagonal, sweeping away up to 3 enemy pieces in its path as it lands.

cards.name: Ghost Legion
cards.description: All your pawns may jump over a blocker one square ahead, landing two ahead where empty, for 2 turns.

cards.name: God Knight
cards.description: One knight becomes an amazon (queen plus knight), for the game.

cards.name: Granite Ramparts
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own back two ranks.

cards.name: Great Wall
cards.description: One full rank you pick is impassable to enemies for 3 turns.

cards.name: Griffon Rider
cards.description: Move up to two of your pieces to any empty squares, once.

cards.name: Haerin
cards.description: Cat's pounce: choose one of your pieces, then an enemy a knight's leap away. Snatch that piece off the board, land yours on its square, and it stands shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Hanni
cards.description: Spotlight: choose an enemy piece. It and every enemy piece within two squares of it are charmed and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings shrug it off.

cards.name: Hexed Satchel
cards.description: Your opponent's next 2 drafted cards arrive nullified and do nothing.

cards.name: Home Field
cards.description: Home advantage: while standing in your own half of the board or one rank past it, each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Homesick
cards.description: Your opponent's army is homesick: every piece may only move toward or along its own back rank for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Hunter Knight
cards.description: One knight captures a piece one leap away and lands a second leap beyond, once.

cards.name: Chains of the Court
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops are chained into stone for 4 of their turns (walnuts that shuffle one square at a time). The chains have a lock: if their KING steps onto one of the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) while the curse holds, every petrified courtier is freed at once. Wait it out in safety, or walk the king into the open to break it early.

cards.name: Creeping Blight
cards.description: Blight one square in your opponent's half of the board: no enemy piece may move onto blighted ground (pieces already standing there may still leave). On each of their next turns the blight creeps to one more adjacent square in their half, for 5 of their turns, then the whole patch withers away. Play around the spread, or stay out of its half entirely.

cards.name: Cursed Coin
cards.description: Press a cursed coin into one enemy piece's hand: for your opponent's next 8 turns the holder cannot capture and can move at most 2 squares. The coin is eager to be passed: whenever the holder ends a move beside another of their pieces, or one of their pieces ends a move beside the holder, the coin jumps to that piece. Quarantining the holder away from the army contains it; capturing the holder yourself destroys the coin. Kings never take the coin.

cards.name: Queen's Ransom
cards.description: A ransom is set on her majesty's steps: for your opponent's next 5 turns, each time they move their queen, two other pieces of theirs (chosen by the curse) are seized as surety and frozen for 1 turn. The queen herself is never restrained: benching her costs nothing, using her taxes the court.

cards.name: Bounty Mark
cards.description: Paint a bounty on one enemy piece for the next 6 of their turns: whenever the marked piece captures anything, it is swarmed by bounty hunters and frozen for 2 of their turns afterward. Marching it around is free; only using it to fight is punished. They can keep it out of combat, or trade it away to shed the mark. Kings carry no bounty.

cards.name: Collapsing Floor
cards.description: Curse one rank in your opponent's half with a slow crack: after 3 of their turns the floor gives way, and every piece of theirs still standing on that rank is caught in the rubble and frozen for 2 of their turns. Their king is never trapped. The rank and the count are both plain to read - march their pieces off it before it caves in.

cards.name: Sleeper Cell
cards.description: Plant a sleeper in one enemy knight or bishop. On their 4th turn from now it wakes and defects: it becomes yours to command for your next 3 turns, then slips back to your opponent. Until it turns, it is still theirs - they can root out the plot by capturing or trading the marked piece before the fuse ends. Kings are never turned.

cards.name: Roaming Maw
cards.description: Tear open a hungry void in your opponent's half. Each of their turns it drifts one square toward their nearest piece, and no enemy piece may move onto the square it occupies. If it reaches a piece (never the king), that piece is swallowed off the board. It hunts for 6 of their turns, then closes. Its next step is always plain to see - keep pieces clear of its path.

cards.name: Shared Fate
cards.description: Stitch the fates of two enemy pieces together for the next 8 of their turns: if you capture one of the pair, the other drops dead in the same instant, wherever it stands. They can break the link by trading one of the two away themselves, or by keeping the pair well guarded so you never take either. A king can never be fate-bound.

cards.name: Wildfire Rot
cards.description: Set a rot on one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns, no rotten piece may capture, and on each of their turns the rot spreads to one more of their pieces standing beside an infected one. Left in a huddle it consumes the whole cluster; kept apart it cannot jump the gap. Capturing a rotten piece burns that infection away. Kings never rot.

cards.name: Hyein
cards.description: Long legs: for the game each of your pawns may also stride straight forward to the first, second, or third empty square ahead, springing over anything in between.

cards.name: Iron Furrow
cards.description: The field is sown with iron spikes: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, and any enemy pawn that captures during that time is caught on the spikes, unable to move for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Iron Reign
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for 2 full turns.

cards.name: Iron Will
cards.description: Whenever your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Ironclad
cards.description: Every piece on your back two ranks, your king aside, cannot be captured for 2 turns.

cards.name: Joseph Leung
cards.description: Sign the board. Bind one of your pieces: for the game it moves as a knight and queen at once, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Last Meal
cards.description: Your king ties on a napkin. For your next 3 turns it may capture any enemy piece (other than a king) up to two squares away, leaping over anything in between.

cards.name: Lava Floor
cards.description: A whole rank erupts into lava: pick any square and its entire rank is barred to your opponent for their next 4 turns, and the eruption throws every enemy piece already on that rank one square back toward its home rank.

cards.name: Lone Sovereign
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king and their knights. Every other piece is stuck fast.

cards.name: Long Leash
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 7 turns.

cards.name: Main Character
cards.description: One of your pieces gets plot armor: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Mass Promote Minor
cards.description: Two pawns on your 4th rank or beyond become knights instantly.

cards.name: Mass Resurrect
cards.description: Revive any four captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

cards.name: Medusa's Verdict
cards.description: Your opponent's queen turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and every enemy piece standing next to her is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Middle Part
cards.description: Not one hair off the axis: choose one of your pieces except the king or queen, and a perfect mirror copy of it materializes on the file-reflected square (a-file to h-file), if that square is empty. Once.

cards.name: Mind Control
cards.description: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop (turn it to your color) for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Minji
cards.description: Leader's guard: every one of your pieces standing within two squares of your king links arms and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns.

cards.name: Mortgage
cards.description: Take out a loan against your home: summon a rook on any empty square. The bank keeps the deed, so you can never castle again for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Nova
cards.description: Sacrifice one pawn to clear every enemy piece except the king from its file, once.

cards.name: One Arm Muscle Up Is My Dream
cards.description: One chosen piece reaches for the bar: forever it also slides diagonally like a bishop, extending one long arm across the board on top of its own moves.

cards.name: Overclock Major
cards.description: All your pieces may move like kings as an alternative, for 1 turn.

cards.name: Palsied Hands
cards.description: Their hands shake after every kill: for your opponent's next 6 turns, they cannot capture on two turns in a row.

cards.name: Parole
cards.description: Your nerf is removed for good after your next 10 turns.

cards.name: Peasant Levy
cards.description: The levy defends only the homeland: for your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only pieces standing in their own half of the board. Anything already across the middle is stranded.

cards.name: Phase Army
cards.description: Your bishops, rooks, and queen pass through one friendly piece per move for 2 turns.

cards.name: Chain Letter
cards.description: Forward to 10 friends or else: a cursed email hops around their army. One random enemy piece freezes each of your opponent's next 3 turns, jumping to a different piece every time. Never a king.

cards.name: Promotion Storm
cards.description: All pawns on your 5th rank or beyond promote to knights.

cards.name: Purge
cards.description: Remove one enemy piece below queen rank from the board.

cards.name: Purge Storm
cards.description: Remove three enemy pawns and freeze the rest for 1 turn.

cards.name: Queen's Handicap
cards.description: Nerf your opponent's queen: for their next 4 turns her every move must end beside another of their own pieces. No escort, no move.

cards.name: Rampart
cards.description: Place a pawn on each of three empty squares you choose in your half; those three pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns.

cards.name: Rehab
cards.description: Check into rehab: your nerf is suspended permanently for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Rent-a-Rook
cards.description: A rook arrives on loan: place it on an empty square in your half. It cannot be captured while it is on loan (it is not yours to lose), then it drives off after 5 of your turns.

cards.name: Riddle Game
cards.description: You wager the deck itself on a dangerous game: your opponent's next two drafts are skipped, but so is your own next one.

cards.name: Rift Walker
cards.description: One piece teleports anywhere on the board, once.

cards.name: Roulette
cards.description: Spin the wheel three times: three random enemy pieces other than the king are removed from the board.

cards.name: The Round Table
cards.description: Two sworn knights answer your call and wait in your pocket: spend a later turn to drop each onto any empty square.

cards.name: Royal Handicap
cards.description: Nerf the crown itself: the patch removes diagonal movement from your opponent's king for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Royal Summons
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they must move their king if it has a legal move.

cards.name: Rubik's Cube
cards.description: Scramble the cube: make up to 3 twists, each swapping the spots of two of your own pieces standing within 2 squares of each other. Kings never twist.

cards.name: Rust
cards.description: Idle enemy pieces seize up: any enemy piece (never a king) that has stood still for 2 of your opponent's turns rusts solid and may only move if the move is a capture, until it finally moves.

cards.name: Bobrito Bandito
cards.description: Bonk one enemy piece with the log: it is stunned and cannot move for its next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

cards.name: Scorched Middle
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the 4th or 5th ranks for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Sever
cards.description: Permanently disable one enemy buff and block its retrigger.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.description: Shatter one enemy rook, bishop, or knight into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Siege Rook
cards.description: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in one move, then the swept rank or file stays barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Skibidi Flush
cards.description: The porcelain vortex opens: up to 3 chosen enemy pieces (never the king) are flushed back to their home squares (or, if home is taken, to the nearest empty square toward home). Nothing is captured; everything is humiliated.

cards.name: Spirit Guide
cards.description: A patient spirit settles into one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it may also step one square in any direction, and it cannot be captured while the spirit stays.

cards.name: Starfall
cards.description: A rook crashes down into your pocket, and a chip of star-iron lands with it as a pawn: drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Starlight Ward
cards.description: Starlight pools around the crown: your pieces standing on the squares beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Stone Curse
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 4 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Stone Golem
cards.description: Bind a spirit into rock and stone: a lumbering golem serves as a rook for 6 of your turns, then crumbles back to rubble.

cards.name: Stone Menagerie
cards.description: Petrify two enemy minor pieces you target (knights or bishops) for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Swap Meet
cards.description: Set up a stall and shake on a deal: your lowest-tier held card and a random one of your opponent's held cards are swapped between you.

cards.name: Thorn Hedge
cards.description: A hedge of black thorns walls off your realm: enemy bishops, rooks, and queens cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Threads of Fate
cards.description: The loom repays every cut thread: for your opponent's next 3 captures, you weave an extra move into your reply.

cards.name: Throne Bound
cards.description: The queen may not stray from her king: for your opponent's next 4 turns, her every move must end within 2 squares of their king.

cards.name: Time Out
cards.description: The referee throws a flag on your opponent: their next draft is skipped and their clock loses 15 seconds.

cards.name: Time Thief
cards.description: Pick your opponent's pocket: steal half of the time left on their clock (up to 75 seconds) and add it to your own.

cards.name: Total Freeze
cards.description: Freeze every enemy piece except the king that stands on a square next to one of your pieces, for 1 turn.

cards.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
cards.description: The drum-man marches on your opponent's king. On each of your next 5 turns, the two enemy pieces nearest their king are bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

cards.name: Twin Queens
cards.description: Promote two pawns to queens instantly if both are on your 5th rank or beyond.

cards.name: Understudy
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, one of your bishops, or a knight if you have no bishop, immediately turns into a queen on its own square. If you have neither, nothing happens. Triggers once.

cards.name: Union Rules
cards.description: Your pieces get mandated rest: for your opponent's next 2 turns after they capture one of your pieces, they cannot make a capture. If capturing is their only legal option, the rule is waived for that turn.

cards.name: Uniqlo Warrior
cards.description: Suit up in the daily fit. Your entire army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Arrest the Hour
cards.description: Freeze one enemy rook or queen for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Border Ward
cards.description: A warded frontier: your opponent may not move any piece into your half of the board for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Conjured Rook
cards.description: Conjure a spectral rook into your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square. It stays as long as you do.

cards.name: Frozen Moment
cards.description: Seal this moment in glass: choose one enemy piece except a king. After 3 of their turns, wherever it has run to, it is snapped back to the square it stands on right now (if that square is free again).

cards.name: Royal Aegis
cards.description: Your king and your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.description: Saboteurs in their war room: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and their reroll token is stolen away if they still hold one.

cards.name: Spelltheft
cards.description: A trade, technically: steal any one of your opponent's unused buffs, but the spell demands payment: your own lowest-tier unused card goes to them in exchange.

cards.name: Stolen Hours
cards.description: Steal 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and take one extra move this turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move.

cards.name: Twin Blink
cards.description: Two knots in the world come undone at once: choose one of your pieces and one enemy piece (kings aside); each blinks away to a random empty square.

cards.name: Twin Familiars
cards.description: A familiar perches on each of your bishops: for the rest of the game your bishops may also step one square straight (up, down, or sideways), finally changing their color.

cards.name: Unmake
cards.description: The next capture your opponent makes is unmade: their piece snaps back to the square it came from, and your captured piece is restored where it stood. Kings cannot be unmade.

cards.name: Walnut Curse
cards.description: Their greed turns to wood: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece becomes a walnut for 3 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time. Kings shrug the curse off.

cards.name: Warden's Bribe
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 6 turns, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Warp Legion
cards.description: The legion rallies to the crown: up to three of your pieces teleport to empty squares beside your king, once.

cards.name: Attack Goose
cards.description: An attack goose invades your opponent's half as a knight for 3 of your turns, then honks off.

cards.name: Berserk Pawn
cards.description: One of your pawns flies into a frenzy: for your next 3 turns it also moves like a queen, then it burns out and is removed from the board.

cards.name: Broken Elevator
cards.description: The lift to your half is out of order: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto either of your two back ranks.

cards.name: Clown Car
cards.description: Two knights pile out of one tiny car: place them on two empty squares that touch each other. Both are too dizzy to move on your next turn.

cards.name: Concrete Shoes
cards.description: Fit one of your opponent's rooks or queens with concrete shoes: it cannot move at all for their next 3 turns, then it hardens into a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Confetti Cannon
cards.description: Your next capture goes off like a confetti cannon: every enemy piece other than a king within two squares of the captured square is blown off the board.

cards.name: Conga Line
cards.description: The whole line dances one step to the side: every one of your pawns shifts one square toward the board edge you pick (pawns with no room sit the song out).

cards.name: Deal with the Devil
cards.description: Sign here: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but the devil collects and you skip your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Haunted House
cards.description: Two rooms turn haunted: mark two empty squares and any enemy piece that enters one, never a king, vanishes. The haunting lasts 4 of your turns.

cards.name: Hot Seat
cards.description: The spotlight swings to their king and queen: on your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their queen.

cards.name: Musical Chairs
cards.description: The music stops: swap the squares of one of your pieces and one of your opponent's pieces, once. Neither may be a king.

cards.name: Repo Rook
cards.description: A repo man's rook rolls up behind enemy lines: place it on an empty square in your opponent's half, and it tows itself away after 3 of your turns.

cards.name: Rubber Duck Squad
cards.description: Your bishops are secretly rubber: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece that captures one of your bishops bounces straight back to the square it came from.

cards.name: Voodoo Doll
cards.description: Stitch a little doll of the enemy army: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a random enemy piece of the very same type is destroyed in sympathy. Kings are never harmed.

cards.name: Wrong Way
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's pieces has its map upside down: for their next 2 turns none of them may retreat toward their own back rank.

cards.name: Arc Lightning
cards.description: One rook arcs lightning along a diagonal, removing up to two enemy pieces in its path (never a king) and landing beyond them. The bolt then jumps to freeze the nearest surviving enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Conflagration
cards.description: Remove two enemy pieces, each a pawn, knight, or bishop, once.

cards.name: Firestorm
cards.description: A firestorm falls on the crossroads: every enemy piece except a king standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) is consumed.

cards.name: Flame Lance
cards.description: One of your rooks breathes a lance of flame straight up its own file, without moving: the first enemy piece in the jet, if it is not a king, burns away. Friendly pieces block the flame, once.

cards.name: Frost Ward
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece that ends a move next to your king in that time is frozen for 1 turn and bonked where it stands.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.description: Your opponent's pieces go numb: for their next 2 turns they cannot make any capture, and no piece may move more than 2 squares.

cards.name: Overgrowth
cards.description: One of your pawns blooms into a queen for your next 3 turns, then withers back into a pawn.

cards.name: Petrify the Ranks
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Quagmire
cards.description: Open two patches of sucking mud on empty squares: any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one is stuck fast for its next 3 turns instead of removed. The mud stays for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Rooted
cards.description: Roots seize the heavy pieces: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Scorch
cards.description: Remove one enemy knight or bishop from the board; the fire spreads to every enemy pawn standing beside it, once.

cards.name: Withering Touch
cards.description: One enemy piece freezes solid for 3 of their turns, then withers to a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Claymore Line
cards.description: Mark two empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto either one, a king aside, is destroyed along with every enemy piece on the squares around it. The mines stay armed for the game.

cards.name: Counter Battery Fire
cards.description: Remove one enemy rook or bishop you name from the board, once.

cards.name: Demolition Charge
cards.description: Rig one of your pieces with charges: for the game, whenever it captures an enemy piece the squares around the capture are cleared of enemy pieces. Kings are never caught in the blast.

cards.name: Form Square
cards.description: Pick any square: your pieces standing on it or any of the up-to-eight squares around it, your king aside, cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Mass Defection
cards.description: Turn two enemy pawns to your side for the rest of the game, once.

cards.name: Muster the Ranks
cards.description: The trumpet sounds and the whole line steps off: every one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square. Pawns one step from the last rank hold their ground.

cards.name: Paratroopers
cards.description: Drop two new pawns onto empty squares in your opponent's half, once. They dig in where they land: neither can be captured for 1 full turn.

cards.name: Pincer Movement
cards.description: Close both jaws at once: every enemy piece except a king caught directly between two of your pieces (left and right, above and below, or across a diagonal) is pinned and frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Praetorian Guard
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it cannot be captured and may also step one square in any direction like a king.

cards.name: Relentless Assault
cards.description: Each of your next two capturing moves immediately grants you an extra move. You cannot capture the king on a bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Spearhead
cards.description: One of your rooks drives in a straight line, capturing up to two enemy pieces in its path and stopping. The squares it punches through stay barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Aegis
cards.description: Every one of your pieces except your king cannot be captured for 1 full turn.

cards.name: All In
cards.description: Push everything to the center. Your next draft offer is skipped. The offer after that shows three cards, and you take all three.

cards.name: Army of the Dead
cards.description: The fallen answer the roll: one pawn musters into your pocket for every two of your pieces captured so far, plus one more, up to five in all. Drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Ascendant Knight
cards.description: One knight moves as an amazon and cannot be captured, for 2 turns.

cards.name: Atomic Reaction
cards.description: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around the captured square is removed, and each removed piece sets off the same blast around itself. Lasts the whole game.

cards.name: Bayview Secondary School
cards.description: Detention for the whole class. Choose a square: every enemy piece except the king in the 3 by 3 around it is locked in place for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: 225 Bench
cards.description: Press 225 and shove up to 4 enemy pieces one square back toward their own home rank. Blocked pieces stay put, nobody is captured.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, all your pieces except your king also move like a queen. For the 2 turns after that, all your pieces can move only one square.

cards.name: Brr Brr Patapim
cards.description: The cold finds whoever wanders alone: every enemy piece except the king with no friendly piece on any square beside it freezes solid for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Buff Siphon
cards.description: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Alchemist's Trade
cards.description: Equivalent exchange: one of your knights, bishops or rooks is transmuted into a queen; in payment, another of your knights, bishops, rooks or queens crumbles into a pawn where it stands (it cannot be standing on a first or last rank).

cards.name: Early Coronation
cards.description: The heralds cannot wait: for your next 3 turns, any pawn move of yours that reaches your opponent's third of the board (their back three ranks) may promote to a queen on the spot.

cards.name: Highwayman's Toll
cards.description: Stand and deliver: your next 3 captures each steal 8 seconds from your opponent's clock and add them to yours. In untimed games the toll collects nothing.

cards.name: Prisoner Exchange
cards.description: Envoys meet at the river: the finest captured piece of EACH side returns to the board at once, each placed on the empty square nearest its own home rank (queens first, then rooks, bishops, knights, pawns). Your opponent's piece comes back too, so trade wisely.

cards.name: Standard Bearer
cards.description: One of your pawns takes up the army's standard: for the rest of the game it may also move like a queen, but never capture that way, and never onto a first or last rank. Its humble pawn captures remain.

cards.name: Castle in the Storm
cards.description: Throw up the walls mid-battle: choose one of your rooks on your king's rank with an empty path to the king, and castle toward it at once (king two squares over, rook to the square it passed) even if your king or that rook has already moved.

cards.name: Funeral Pyre
cards.description: Light one of your own and let it take the neighbors with it: choose any of your pieces (your king aside). It is removed, and every enemy piece on a square adjacent to it is destroyed in the blast. Shielded enemies and enemy kings survive.

cards.name: Last Muster
cards.description: Call up whoever is left in the village: place up to 3 pawns on empty squares in your half. They hold the line, then disband four of your turns later, vanishing from the board.

cards.name: Rally to the King
cards.description: Call the nearest blade home: teleport any one of your pieces (your king aside) to an empty square directly adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Second Face
cards.description: It learns a second way to move: choose one of your bishops, and for the rest of the game it may also leap like a knight, keeping all of its bishop moves as well.

cards.name: Vantage Point
cards.description: Dig in on the heights and they cannot dislodge you: any of your pieces (your king aside) standing on your opponent's back two ranks cannot be captured. Step back off the heights and it is fair game again.

cards.name: Cappuccino Assassino
cards.description: The espresso assassin strikes before the foam settles: the enemy piece nearest your king (never their king) is destroyed, and the two enemy pieces nearest the scene of the crime are stunned for their next turn.

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.description: Clear all enemy pawns on the board.

cards.name: Celestial Ascension
cards.description: Your bishops ascend to a higher plane: for the game every one of them also moves in straight lines like a rook, wielding a queen's full reach.

cards.name: Chess Diff
cards.description: Chess diff! The game is paused and a fresh, completely normal game of 1+0 chess is played on a clean board: no drafts, no nerfs, no buffs. Whoever WINS the diff seizes an apex (tier 9) buff, then the paused game (board and clocks) resumes.

cards.name: Clone Army
cards.description: Four photocopier flashes in a row: four new pawns land in your pocket, ready to drop onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Colossus
cards.description: One piece becomes uncapturable and gains queen movement for 3 turns.

cards.name: Court in Exile
cards.description: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king, and their queen is the last to return from exile: she cannot move for 2 further turns after the court comes back.

cards.name: Creeping Frost
cards.description: Freeze three enemy pieces (not the king) for 2 of their owner's turns.

cards.name: Blackjack
cards.description: The dealer feeds you cards until your hand reaches seventeen, then you stand. Hit twenty one for a rook in your pocket and 45 seconds. Stand on seventeen to twenty for a minor piece in your pocket. Bust over twenty one and the house takes your weakest piece while you cool off for two turns.

cards.name: Poker Bluff
cards.description: You shove all in holding nothing and stare them down. Roughly forty five times in a hundred they fold and you rake one of their pieces into the pot along with 20 seconds. The rest of the time they call your bluff, and you pay your weakest piece and take a two turn walk of shame.

cards.name: The Death Arcana
cards.description: The thirteenth card turns face up and names its mark: choose one enemy piece except a king. It is doomed: after 4 of their turns it dies, wherever it has run to. Only being captured first spares it the mark.

cards.name: Detonation Field
cards.description: Your next three captures each explode adjacent enemy pieces.

cards.name: Divine Mandate
cards.description: You speak with the authority of heaven: one enemy knight, bishop, or rook joins your army, and heaven shields the defection so it cannot be recaptured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Kings cannot be swayed.

cards.name: Double Amazon
cards.description: All your knights move as amazons for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Draft Seize
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft and skip your opponent's next, though they gain a reroll in return.

cards.name: Dragon Mount
cards.description: One of your knights breaks a young dragon to the saddle: for the game it may also slide any distance diagonally.

cards.name: Empty Handed
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is blocked and skipped, and every draft reroll they still hold is stolen and added to yours.

cards.name: Eternal Statue
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Fissure
cards.description: One file becomes impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Full Planche
cards.description: Lock one of your pieces into a perfect hold. It hovers uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns and slides like a rook along every open rank and file for the game.

cards.name: Geometry Dash
cards.description: One of your pieces hits the beat: it dashes straight forward, phasing over your own pieces and smashing up to 2 enemies in its lane before landing. Never kings.

cards.name: Giant's Maul
cards.description: The maul comes down once: crush one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and the shock leaves every enemy piece beside it (kings aside) frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Glacial Flanks
cards.description: Freeze your opponent's knights and bishops for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Glass Cannon
cards.description: Choose a bishop. For your next 4 turns it can capture any enemy except the king along its diagonals, passing through anything in between. But while it is overcharged, if it is captured, two of your pawns shatter with it.

cards.name: God-King
cards.description: Your king walks between heartbeats: it may also leap like a knight, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Golden Touch
cards.description: The next two enemy pieces you capture (other than kings) are reforged as your own and added to your army on empty squares in your half. The price of greed: each reforging turns one of your pawns to gold, and it is lost.

cards.name: Gossamer Veil
cards.description: A shimmering veil of spider-silk tangles every long blade: your pieces cannot be captured by enemy bishops, rooks, or queens for your opponent's next 3 turns. Pawns, knights, and kings still cut through.

cards.name: Grand Summon
cards.description: Add a knight and a bishop to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.description: Your king bends space around it: enemy pieces standing within two squares of your king are caught in orbit and cannot move to a square farther from it. Enemy kings are not affected.

cards.name: Grounded Command
cards.description: The heavy pieces are grounded: for your opponent's next 4 turns their queen and rooks cannot move onto any square in your half of the board. They move freely within their own.

cards.name: Groundhog Day
cards.description: The board hits a VHS rewind on your opponent: whichever piece they move on their next turn, they must move that same piece again on the two turns after. If that piece can no longer move, the loop is skipped.

cards.name: Guardian Angel
cards.description: Twice per game, when your opponent captures one of your pieces (not your king), that piece is spirited to safety instead: an identical piece reappears on an empty square deep in your own half.

cards.name: Horn of Summoning
cards.description: One long note wakes the stone itself: for the rest of the game, your rooks may also step one square diagonally.

cards.name: Gathering Storm
cards.description: A storm gathers over their army and worsens every two turns, for your opponent's next 6 turns. Turns 1 and 2: their pawns cannot advance (captures still allowed). Turns 3 and 4: their knights and bishops also cannot cross into your half. Turns 5 and 6: their bishops, rooks and queen are also capped at 2 squares per move. Then it breaks all at once. The early turns are the time to act.

cards.name: Gilded Rot
cards.description: Whatever they touch turns to gold: for your opponent's next 5 turns, each piece they move is gilded, and gilded pieces cannot capture for the rest of the curse. Unmoved pieces keep their teeth, so they must choose between developing their game and keeping their army dangerous. When the curse ends the gold flakes off everything at once.

cards.name: Gravebloom
cards.description: Flowers with long memories: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every square where they capture becomes a grave-garden for 3 of their turns: the capturing piece may leave, but no enemy piece may move onto that square while it blooms. Each kill costs them the ground it was won on; capturing less, or only on squares they don't need, is the way through.

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.description: Snow gathers silently over their half for 3 of their turns, then comes down all at once. For the 3 turns after it falls, their pieces may not move onto any empty square in their own half - only captures and moves into your half remain. Whatever ground they already hold is safe footing, so spreading out before it drops is the counter. If it ever leaves them no move, they play freely that turn.

cards.name: Doomed Vow
cards.description: Condemn one enemy piece with a vow only their king can answer: in 5 of their turns it is dragged off the board, unless their own king comes to stand on a square next to it before then, which breaks the vow at once. Their king must leave shelter to save it - or they abandon the piece and keep the king safe. The count is on the card throughout. Kings themselves cannot be condemned.

cards.name: Effigy of Dread
cards.description: Raise a leering effigy on an empty square in your opponent's half. While it stands, every square around it is barred to their pieces, and the dread lingers for 6 of their turns before it topples. It is not invincible: the effigy is a piece they can capture, and smashing it ends the curse at once. Route around its shadow, or send a piece to break it.

cards.name: Feeding Frenzy
cards.description: A parasite curse that feeds on other curses: for your opponent's next 6 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen have their reach capped, and the cap tightens for every other curse-effect already afflicting them (each frozen or petrified piece, sealed square, or royal edict). On a clean board it barely bites; on a board buried in hexes it clamps their long pieces to a crawl. Cleansing the other curses loosens this one.

cards.name: Hydra Hex
cards.description: Brand one enemy piece as the hydra's head, for the next 8 of their turns. If you cut it off (capture the branded piece), two heads grow back: the two enemy pieces nearest where it fell are frozen for 2 of their turns each. Leaving the head alone lets the curse expire harmlessly; capturing it while it stands alone, far from help, gives the new heads nothing to seize. Kings are neither head nor spawn.

cards.name: Standing Guard
cards.description: A cruel duty binds their bodyguard: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every time their king moves, whichever of their pieces stands nearest the king is frozen in place for 1 of their turns, rooted to watch over the empty throne. Keeping the king still keeps the guard free. The king itself is never frozen.

cards.name: I Love Cami
cards.description: Place Cami on an empty square in your half: a queen who also leaps like a knight. Devotion: allies standing beside her cannot be captured. If she is ever taken, her captor is frozen for 2 turns.

cards.name: I Love NewJeans
cards.description: Harmony: for the game, every non-king piece of yours that stands next to a friendly piece may also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: I Love Chaewon
cards.description: Fearless choreography: gracefully reposition up to 3 of your pieces, gliding each to any empty square in your own half of the board.

cards.name: I Love Making Out
cards.description: Bond two of your pieces for the game. Each also moves the way the other does, blending a knight with a bishop or a rook with a queen.

cards.name: Judgment Day
cards.description: A pillar of holy light smites one enemy knight, bishop, rook, or queen you name, then petrifies the two enemy pieces nearest the impact into stone for the rest of the game. Kings are never petrified.

cards.name: Kraken
cards.description: A kraken surfaces on an empty square. For your opponent's next 3 turns, at the end of each of their turns it drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward it whenever the square between is empty, then seizes any enemy piece left next to it so that piece cannot move on its next turn. Kings are never dragged or seized, and the kraken's square cannot be entered.

cards.name: Landlord
cards.description: Claim four empty squares as your property. Any enemy piece (never a king) that ends its move on one of them owes rent: it is stuck fast for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Leaden Fields
cards.description: Their pawns are cast in lead: every advanced enemy pawn first sinks one square back toward home (if that square is free), and then their pawns cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Lich Phylactery
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, a new queen appears on her home square, or on the nearest empty square of your back rank if her home is taken.

cards.name: Lightning Strike
cards.description: Call lightning down on up to three enemy knights, bishops, or pawns, removing them from the board.

cards.name: Lost Days
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns entirely.

cards.name: Lunar Eclipse
cards.description: The moon slides into shadow and the enemy's great powers still with it: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Magnetism
cards.description: Your knights are magnetized: after each knight move, the nearest enemy piece (never a king) is dragged up to two squares toward that knight, as long as the squares between them are empty.

cards.name: Mind Dominion
cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or bishop for the game.

cards.name: Minefield
cards.description: Seed three mines on empty squares. The first enemy piece, never a king, to step on each mine is destroyed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

cards.name: Mirror of Souls
cards.description: You hold the glass between two reflections: one of your pieces trades places with an enemy piece of the same kind. Kings cast no reflection.

cards.name: Nerf Breaker
cards.description: Remove your nerf entirely for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Nerf Hammer
cards.description: Bring down the nerf hammer: turn one enemy knight, bishop, or rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns. It can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Nerf This
cards.description: The balance team finally answers: one enemy queen you point at is patched down to a bishop where she stands.

cards.name: Overwhelm
cards.description: Take three moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Pay to Win
cards.description: Money buys more of whatever is working: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, and a store-bought copy of it joins your pocket, ready to drop onto an empty square on a later turn.

cards.name: Purge Line
cards.description: Remove every enemy piece below queen rank on one rank you pick.

cards.name: Queen of Stone
cards.description: The curse waits in her shoes: the next time your opponent moves their queen, she turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns the moment she lands.

cards.name: Queen's Wrath
cards.description: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line, removing up to two enemy pieces on it, then freezes every enemy piece beside her landing square for their next turn; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

cards.name: Resurrect Queen
cards.description: Bring your captured queen back to any empty square on the board, and she cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Royal Ascension
cards.description: Your king gains queen movement permanently (still loses on capture).

cards.name: Sealed Avenues
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the d or e files for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Second King
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns, on any rank, into a second king. Your opponent must capture both of your kings to win.

cards.name: Sinkhole
cards.description: The earth chooses where to open: three sinkholes appear on random empty squares in your opponent's half. Any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one plunges out of the game. They stay open the rest of the match.

cards.name: Smurf Account
cards.description: A suspiciously strong new player joins your side mid-game: place a fresh rook on an empty square in your half.

cards.name: Stone Bastions
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and each stone bastion seals its ground: for their next 3 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto the files their petrified rooks stand on.

cards.name: Stone Prelates
cards.description: The pews claim whoever lingers: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any of their bishops standing in their own half may only shuffle one square at a time. Bishops that cross into your half move freely.

cards.name: Stone Riders
cards.description: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and the stone is catching: on each of those turns one random enemy piece standing beside a stone rider is petrified for 1 turn too.

cards.name: Termites
cards.description: Termites gnaw at your opponent's towers: every 2 of their turns, their rooks lose one more square of reach. The decay stops at a reach of 1, so a rook can always shuffle a single square.

cards.name: The Big Chill
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 3 of their turns, but the thaw is uneven: at the end of each of their turns, one random frozen piece shakes free of the ice early.

cards.name: Time Rewind
cards.description: Turn back time: restore some of your clock and free all of your own frozen or petrified pieces, once.

cards.name: Time Stop (Short)
cards.description: Time stops: freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 turn, then take one extra move right now, once. You cannot capture the king during the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Total Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in piece upgrades resist.

cards.name: Total Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard buries every sightline: for their next 3 turns, your opponent's pieces can only capture at arm's length, exactly one square away.

cards.name: Unseelie Bargain
cards.description: Free action: strike a bargain with the dark court and take two extra moves right now. The price comes due and you skip your next turn.

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.description: A chooser of the slain rides beside your army: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight, bishop, or rook of yours they capture is carried home to your pocket instead of being lost for good. Drop it back onto an empty square on a later turn.

cards.name: Void
cards.description: The void takes one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop, and the square it stood on stays a void that swallows any enemy piece except a king that enters it, for the game.

cards.name: Greed
cards.description: Your next draft offer, you take both cards instead of choosing one.

cards.name: Leaden Crown
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns into a queen, and the leaden crown guards it: that new queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Wall of Thorns
cards.description: A thicket of undying thorns bursts up around an empty square: your opponent can never enter any of the 8 squares around it, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Warp Storm
cards.description: Move up to four of your pieces, your king aside, one square each in any direction onto an empty square, once.

cards.name: Double Trouble
cards.description: One of your knights or bishops splits in two: place its exact twin on an empty square right beside it.

cards.name: Juggling Act
cards.description: Keep every plate spinning: take three extra moves right now, then it all comes crashing down and you skip your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Sticky Floor
cards.description: The whole floor is flypaper: every one of your opponent's pieces may move at most one square for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Wrecking Ball
cards.description: Your queen takes one full swing in place: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her is smashed off the board. Shielded pieces resist the swing, once.

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.description: Freeze every enemy piece standing next to your king for their next 2 turns and bonk it where it stands.

cards.name: Flood
cards.description: Three floodwaters spread over empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto each (never a king) is swept off the board. They stay for 2 of your turns.

cards.name: Glacier Wall
cards.description: Two walls of ice rise: pick any two squares and each of their files becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Hellfire Beam
cards.description: The beam scorches an X across the board: pick any square, and both diagonals through it stay burning: your opponent cannot move onto them for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Immolation
cards.description: Offer one of your own pawns to the flame: it is consumed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the fire.

cards.name: Mountain Range
cards.description: Three peaks heave up out of the board: pick three empty squares; your opponent's pieces can never move onto them, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Thorn Barrier
cards.description: A hedge of thorns bursts up on an empty square: your opponent cannot enter any of the 8 squares around it for their next 3 turns, and any enemy piece already caught in that ring is snared and cannot move for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.description: Curse one of your pawns with lycanthropy: every 5 of your turns it transforms into a knight, and 5 turns later back into a pawn, for the game. If it promotes or is captured the curse lifts.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.description: Spin the wheel for one of six random effects: plus 55 seconds to your clock, minus 55 seconds off your opponent's, your army uncapturable for their next 2 turns, a new knight in your half, every enemy piece asleep for their next 2 turns, or two random enemy pieces other than the king removed.

cards.name: The Wild Hunt
cards.description: The horns of the twilight court sound: pick any square, and the Hunt rides both diagonals through it, carrying off every enemy piece on them. Kings are never taken.

cards.name: Armored Breakthrough
cards.description: One of your bishops spearheads the drive: it sweeps along one diagonal, capturing every enemy piece on it, and stops where the drive ends. Friendly pieces and enemy kings block the drive, once.

cards.name: Bridgehead
cards.description: Place a new knight and a new pawn on empty squares in your opponent's half, once.

cards.name: Combined Arms
cards.description: Armor learns from cavalry: for your next 3 turns, your rooks may also leap like knights.

cards.name: Double Trench
cards.description: Pick two files: your opponent cannot move onto either file for their next 2 turns, and any enemy piece standing on those files cannot capture in that time.

cards.name: Forward Outpost
cards.description: Place a new rook on any empty square in your opponent's half, once.

cards.name: Iron Bulwark
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces, your king aside: while it stands in your half it cannot be captured, and enemy pieces standing next to it cannot capture at all.

cards.name: Mercenary Queen
cards.description: Hire a sellsword who fights as a queen for 3 of your turns, then rides off with her pay.

cards.name: Aegis of the Ages
cards.description: Lift the ancient aegis and its ward falls over your whole host, your king included: nothing you own can be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Amazon
cards.description: Your queen is crowned an Amazon: for the game she also moves like a knight.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.description: Remove any two enemy pieces below the queen from the board.

cards.name: Blood Pact
cards.description: Sign in blood: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but another pawn of yours, you choose which, bursts and is lost.

cards.name: Bolt Hole
cards.description: Old castles keep old secrets: while your king is in check, it may escape through the walls to any empty square within 2 squares of where it stands. The passage bears 2 such escapes, then collapses.

cards.name: Carnival of Masks
cards.description: Ring the carnival bell: every one of your pieces except your king puts on another's mask. Their types are shuffled among their squares at random. The army keeps exactly the same pieces, but nobody is where their powers say they are. Pawns never land on a first or last rank.

cards.name: Kingmaker's Pact
cards.description: Sign with the power behind every throne: every one of your future drafts rolls one tier higher, for the rest of the game. In exchange you forfeit ALL of your draft rerolls, now and forever. The hand you are dealt is the hand you play.

cards.name: Restitution
cards.description: The scales demand balance: for every kind of piece where your opponent outnumbers you on the board, one of your captured pieces of that kind returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. Played from ahead, it restores nothing.

cards.name: From the Ashes
cards.description: The dead are called back only far enough to make it even: your captured pieces return one at a time to your home rank, strongest first, until your non-king pieces number exactly as many as your opponent's. From ahead or level, nobody rises.

cards.name: Futures Market
cards.description: Mortgage the near future for one shot at the very top: your next 2 drafts are skipped, and the draft that follows them deals a rare apex-tier offer, letting you take one of two apex cards.

cards.name: High Stakes
cards.description: Sweep the table twice: you keep every card offered in each of your next 2 drafts instead of just one. In return you forfeit all of your rerolls, now and forever.

cards.name: King's Sanctuary
cards.description: Spirit the king home to the quietest corner: your king is moved to the empty square on your home rank that sits furthest from any enemy piece, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Kingsguard Duel
cards.description: Honor demands the guards settle it: remove one enemy piece standing beside your opponent's king, and in payment remove one of your own pieces standing beside your king. Both monarchs are left a little more exposed.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.description: Raise the shield wall around everything and pay for it later: for the next 3 turns none of your pieces can be captured and your king cannot be taken. The smiths take their due up front - your next 3 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Martyrdom
cards.description: One of yours falls so two of theirs must: destroy one of your own knights or bishops, then remove any two of your opponent's knights or bishops from the board. Every loss here is real.

cards.name: Mummers' Dance
cards.description: The masks come round and everyone swaps: every one of your knights becomes a bishop and every one of your bishops becomes a knight, all at once, where they stand. Your material is unchanged, only re-tasked. While the troupe is changing costume, none of the re-tasked minors can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Chain Atomic
cards.description: Every capture by or against your pieces sets off an atomic blast that clears enemy pieces around it and chains, for the game. When an enemy captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is destroyed too.

cards.name: Chaos Theory
cards.description: A tornado sweeps the board: every pawn, yours and your opponent's, is randomly reshuffled among the squares pawns currently stand on. Happens once.

cards.name: Checkmate Denial
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for the next 5 turns.

cards.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
cards.description: The banana-monkey goes ape: for the game every one of your knights may also slide like a queen, keeping its knight leap on top.

cards.name: Chisel Curse
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the enemy pieces directly to its left and right into walnuts for 2 of their turns each. Kings are never affected.

cards.name: Cockatrice Gaze
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop standing in your half of the board turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns. The minors still in their own half only catch the reflection: they are frozen for 1 turn.

cards.name: Contagion
cards.description: Freezes are catching: whenever one of your opponent's pieces is newly frozen, one adjacent enemy piece (never a king) catches it and is frozen for 2 of their turns. Each fresh freeze spreads at most one square, so it never runs away.

cards.name: Loot Box
cards.description: Pay to crack the crate and pray to the drop table. Legendary (rare) grants a random apex card. Epic grants a bishop and 30 seconds. Rare grants a knight. Common grants a pawn. But almost one crate in three is a mimic that bites off your weakest piece and leaves you shaken for two turns.

cards.name: Deep Freeze
cards.description: A cold snap rolls over their homeland: every enemy piece except the king still in its own half is frozen for 2 of their turns. Pieces that already crossed the border escape it.

cards.name: Divine Legion
cards.description: Add a queen to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Draft Tyranny
cards.description: Set both of your own next cards to tier 7, once.

cards.name: Dragonslayer
cards.description: The old blade remembers its work: name one enemy rook or queen and it is slain where it stands.

cards.name: Eternal Reign
cards.description: Your king gains permanent queen movement and cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Fingertip Maltese
cards.description: Elite fingertip hold on one enemy piece: it freezes for their next 3 turns and the eight squares around it are sealed, so nothing can rescue or relieve it.

cards.name: Fortress Realm
cards.description: A 3x3 zone you pick makes your pieces there, your king aside, uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns.

cards.name: Frozen Solid
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece you target and one enemy piece standing next to it for 3 of their turns each. Kings cannot be chosen.

cards.name: Full Pardon
cards.description: Remove your nerf for good and take an extra move on your next turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Full Rewind
cards.description: Send up to five of your pieces back to their original home squares, once.

cards.name: Glacial Tomb
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 2 of their turns. As the ice melts each one becomes a walnut for 2 more turns, able to shuffle only one square at a time.

cards.name: Godslayer Knight
cards.description: One knight moves as an amazon, is uncapturable, and explodes on capture, for 3 turns.

cards.name: Grand Malediction
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the next card they draft arrives nullified and inert.
