cards.name: Grand Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in upgrades resist.

cards.name: Grand Resurrection
cards.description: Revive your queen and one minor piece to your half.

cards.name: Grand Retreat
cards.description: Return your army to its free starting squares, once (blocked pieces stay put).

cards.name: Great Divide
cards.description: One full rank you pick becomes impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Hex of Stone
cards.description: A creeping grey hex hardens the enemy's flanks: every one of your opponent's knights and bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and for those 4 turns their rooks and queen may slide no more than two squares.

cards.name: Death Knell
cards.description: Toll the knell over one enemy piece you target: in 4 of their turns it crumbles to dust and is removed. The bell accepts one bribe: if the doomed piece captures anything before the last toll, the curse breaks and it lives. Your opponent sees the count the whole time: they can feed the bell a pawn, spend the piece in a trade, or gamble on saving it. Kings cannot be tolled.

cards.name: The Hollow Crown
cards.description: The crown itself is cursed, for the rest of the game: whenever your opponent's king moves (castling included), the court mourns: on their FOLLOWING turn they may move only pawns or the king. The curse sleeps as long as the king holds still, so they must choose between a frozen throne and a stumbling court every time the king needs to act.

cards.name: Tide of Ash
cards.description: Ash rolls in over their homeland: their 1st rank is buried at once, and the tide swallows one more of their home ranks on each of their next 3 turns, up to their 4th rank. Buried ground cannot be moved ONTO by your opponent (pieces standing in the ash may still climb out), so their army is herded forward rank by rank. The whole tide blows away after their 6th turn.

cards.name: The Long Eclipse
cards.description: A shadow crosses the sun over their army. For their first 3 turns nothing seems wrong, then the eclipse falls: for the following 3 of their turns their bishops and queen are blind and cannot move at all. The knights, rooks, pawns and king see fine throughout. The schedule is fixed - use the diagonal pieces before the dark, and rely on the others during it.

cards.name: The Enemy Within
cards.description: Whisper treason to one enemy rook or queen. Over the next 8 of their turns, the third time they move that piece, its patience snaps and it defects: it serves you for your next 4 turns, then returns to them. Working it hard is what turns it - they can leave it standing, or trade it away, to keep it loyal. If it is captured while it fights for you, the treason ends. Kings never turn.

cards.name: Pyrrhic Toll
cards.description: Victory itself is cursed: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time any of their pieces captures, the army mourns and one of their other pieces (chosen by the curse) is frozen for 1 of their turns. Every kill they take costs them a beat somewhere else on the board. Refusing trades avoids the toll entirely; a grinding, capture-heavy game bleeds them dry. Kings never mourn.

cards.name: I Love My Sister
cards.description: Bring your strongest fallen piece home to an empty square in your half. She arrives shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Jackpot
cards.description: Pull the lever for a one-in-two shot at a random apex card, one of the game's most powerful. Miss, and the consolation is still rich: your next draft rolls one tier higher and offers three cards instead of two.

cards.name: King's Legion
cards.description: Add a rook, a knight, and a pawn to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: La Vaca Saturno Saturnita
cards.description: The ringed cow swings into orbit: place a new knight on any empty square along the board's outer rim. While it settles into orbit it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lost Fortnight
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, their next draft is skipped, and 20 seconds are struck off their clock.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.description: Destroy every enemy piece on one rank and one file that cross at a square you pick.

cards.name: Mind Empire
cards.description: Take control of one enemy piece of any type below queen for the game.

cards.name: Molten Heart
cards.description: Their blades run molten: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece is destroyed along with its victim. Kings burn nothing and are never destroyed.

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.description: Raise your strongest fallen piece as a spectre on an empty square in your half. It fights for you, then crumbles to dust after 6 of your turns. If nothing of yours has been captured, nothing rises.

cards.name: Nerf Reversal
cards.description: Turn your nerf against itself: remove it for good, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Noble Rout
cards.description: The nobles break and run: for your opponent's next 3 turns their knights, bishops, rooks and queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Only their pawns and king may still advance.

cards.name: Obsidian Bastions
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 4 of their turns, and from then on those rooks can never capture again for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.description: The whole army surges: for your next 3 turns, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Orb of Dominion
cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or queen for the rest of the game, once. While you still hold the dominated piece, the enemy queen cannot capture. Kings cannot be taken.

cards.name: Overclocked
cards.description: Crank the clock speed: add 75 seconds to your own clock. Then everything runs hot and has to cool down, so for your next 3 turns all your pieces can move only one square.

cards.name: Phoenix Line
cards.description: Revive all your captured pawns to your 2nd rank, once.

cards.name: Purge Realm
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor piece from one half of the board.

cards.name: Queen's Rampage
cards.description: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line you choose and removes every enemy piece on it; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

cards.name: Rift Storm
cards.description: Teleport up to two of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, then swap the squares of two enemy pieces caught in the churn, once.

cards.name: Roost of Rocs
cards.description: Three titanic rocs descend and perch along the board's edge: place three knights on empty squares of the outer rim.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.description: Clear all enemy pawns, and destroy one enemy minor piece (or a rook if they have no minor).

cards.name: Sabbatical
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 10 turns.

cards.name: Salted Earth
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns can never advance again for the rest of the game; they may still capture diagonally. On top of that, for their next 3 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own 4th rank.

cards.name: Sealed Archive
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped entirely, and the draft after that is forced to roll at tier 1: only the dregs seep out of a sealed vault.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Your queen captures every enemy piece along one diagonal in a single move; for each piece reaped, a friendly pawn rises on an empty square in your half, plus one bonus pawn, once.

cards.name: Sovereign Draft
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft.

cards.name: Statue Garden
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Summon Dragon
cards.description: An actual dragon answers: place a new queen on an empty square in your half. Whenever she captures, she breathes fire: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her kill is also removed. Shielded pieces resist the flame.

cards.name: Throne and Silence
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king, and their next draft is skipped entirely.

cards.name: Time Freeze
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, then on their following turn every enemy piece except the king is frozen.

cards.name: Triple Amazon
cards.description: All your knights become amazons for the game, and each may also pass through one friendly piece per move.

cards.name: Unshackled Wrath
cards.description: Remove your nerf for good. Your opponent skips their next turn.

cards.name: Grand Dominion
cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or queen: it becomes yours, once.

cards.name: Walnut Court
cards.description: The whole court hardens where it sits: every enemy piece except the king still on its own back rank turns into a walnut for 3 of their turns. A walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Warp Cataclysm
cards.description: Teleport up to four of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

cards.name: Warp Sovereign
cards.description: Swap up to three pairs of your pieces, once. Stop after any pair.

cards.name: Genie Wish
cards.description: You wished for a queen and the genie obliges, with a flourish of fine print: a new queen appears in your pocket, and a knight appears in your OPPONENT'S. Both drop onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Landslide
cards.description: The whole slope gives way: every enemy piece except the king is pushed one square back toward its own home rank. Pieces with no room behind them stand fast.

cards.name: Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard freezes every enemy piece except the king and pawns for their next 2 turns. The pawns can still trudge.

cards.name: Withered Hands
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture with any piece for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: World Lock
cards.description: Seal the border: your opponent cannot move any piece into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Dug-In Defense
cards.description: Dig three foxholes: choose up to three of your pieces; they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: High Ground
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: for the game it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half.

cards.name: Abdication Edict
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only their king. Every other piece is stuck fast.

cards.name: Absolute Aegis
cards.description: Every one of your pieces cannot be captured for 2 full turns, and this time that includes your king.

cards.name: Absolute Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs and block their next draft, but they gain a reroll in return. Locked-in upgrades resist.

cards.name: Absolute Zero
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 2 of their turns. The cold outlives the ice: for their next 2 turns after the thaw, every piece they move can only step a single square.

cards.name: Age of Heroes
cards.description: For your next 2 turns the old songs come true: each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also move like a queen.

cards.name: Amazon Army
cards.description: All your knights and bishops become amazons for the game.

cards.name: Ban Hammer
cards.description: Moderator privileges activated: point at one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and EVERY enemy piece of that type is permanently banned from the board.

cards.name: Blighted Furrows
cards.description: The blight takes whatever ripened first: every enemy pawn standing in your half of the board rots away and is removed, and their remaining pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Blitzkrieg
cards.description: Take four moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
cards.description: The bomber-croc drops its payload on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is destroyed.

cards.name: Buff Plunder
cards.description: Steal three active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: The Eternal Keep
cards.description: Your home rank is raised into a fortress that never falls: your pieces standing on your first rank (your king excepted) can never be captured, for the rest of the game. Step off the rampart, and the stone no longer knows you.

cards.name: The Great Return
cards.description: The gates of the underworld open both ways: every captured piece of BOTH sides still owed to the board returns at once, each placed on empty squares nearest its own home rank. The side that has lost more, regains more.

cards.name: The Long Truce
cards.description: Heralds cross the field and every blade is lowered: for 2 full turns, no piece on EITHER side can be captured, kings included. While the truce holds you breathe freely: your own nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Shadow Reserve
cards.description: Open the coat: a knight, a bishop and a rook slip into your pocket, ready to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns (each drop spends that turn). The smugglers take their fee up front: your next 2 drafts are skipped outright.

cards.name: Covenant of Return
cards.description: Swear the covenant and death loses its next three arguments: the next 3 of your pieces that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Drive Them Out
cards.description: Clear the homeland and let the invaders regret the crossing: every enemy piece standing in your half of the board is removed, and every one of your own pieces standing in your opponent's half is removed with them. Both kings are spared.

cards.name: Pretender to the Throne
cards.description: Crown a claimant out of thin air: a brand new queen strides onto an empty square on your home rank. The court is not cheap - your next 3 drafts are skipped and you forfeit all of your rerolls.

cards.name: The Homecoming
cards.description: The veterans are called back to the colors: your best captured major (a queen, or else a rook) and your best captured minor (a bishop, or else a knight) both return to empty squares nearest your home rank. The muster costs you your next 2 drafts.

cards.name: The Reckoning
cards.description: Call in every debt the minor pieces owe: every knight and every bishop on the board, yours and your opponent's alike, is removed at once. Kings, queens, rooks and pawns are untouched.

cards.name: Turn the Tide
cards.description: The whole line surges as one: every one of your pawns that can advance takes one step forward at once, wherever the square ahead is empty. Pawns that would reach the final rank hold their ground.

cards.name: Cataclysmic Meteor
cards.description: Destroy every enemy piece within a 3x3 area you pick except the king.

cards.name: Celestial Alignment
cards.description: The stars chart the light squares and hold everything found there: every enemy piece except the king standing on a light square is frozen for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Check Out Our Socials
cards.description: Go live to the whole board. Every enemy piece except the king freezes for their next 2 turns while your hyped-up side takes 2 extra moves right now.

cards.name: Crown and Castle
cards.description: Your opponent's queen and rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Divine Fortress
cards.description: Every piece on your half of the board, your king aside, is uncapturable for 3 turns.

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: For your next 5 turns your king may move and capture as a queen, and it cannot be captured.

cards.name: Draft Supremacy
cards.description: Take both cards in each of your next two drafts while your opponent's next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Endless Night
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns. On the turn they finally return, every enemy piece except their king is frozen for that one turn, so only their king may move.

cards.name: Endless Turn
cards.description: Take moves until you make a capture, once (minimum one move).

cards.name: Eternal Freeze
cards.description: Turn every enemy knight, bishop, rook, and queen to stone for 3 of their turns: each can only shuffle one square at a time. Enemy pawns are left free.

cards.name: Everfrost Shard
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 4 of their turns. The shard radiates: for those 4 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto a square beside it. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Extinction
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor and pawn piece from the board.

cards.name: Full Resurrection
cards.description: Revive your queen, both rooks, and one minor piece to your half.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.description: Reset the entire board to the opening position with your nerf removed, once.

cards.name: Grand Reset
cards.description: Add replacements to your pocket until your army would be back to full starting strength, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Heaven's Wrath
cards.description: The sky splits and three bolts of wrath descend: smite three enemy knights, bishops, rooks, or queens you name from the board.

cards.name: Beacon of Woe
cards.description: Light a doom-beacon on one of your OWN pieces, in full view of both players: when your opponent's 6th turn from now ends, every enemy knight, bishop, rook and queen is frozen for 2 of their turns. Snuffing the flame is the only cure: if they capture the beacon-bearer before it strikes, the curse dies with it. You must keep the bearer alive for six turns; they must decide whether to spend those turns hunting it.

cards.name: Crown of Thorns
cards.description: A briar is woven around your king, in full view: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any enemy piece whose move leaves your king in check is seized by the thorns and frozen for 2 of their turns where it stands. The check still counts, but the attacker is rooted, and the follow-up must come from somewhere else. Attacking anything BUT your king costs them nothing.

cards.name: Pauper's Crown
cards.description: Strip the crown from their queen: she is humbled into a ROOK for 4 of their turns, then restored. Blood restores pride sooner: the moment she captures anything while humbled, she becomes a queen again on the spot. She still fights as a full rook the whole time, and if she is captured while humbled she is simply lost as a rook. Requires an enemy queen on the board.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.description: A tithe is levied on every kill: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever they capture anything larger than a pawn, one of their own pawns (chosen by the curse) is claimed as tribute and removed from the board. Trading pawn for pawn is untaxed; every heavier trade quietly costs them a pawn on top. Once they have no pawns left, the tithe goes unpaid. Refusing trades starves it entirely.

cards.name: The Curse Engine
cards.description: A grinding machine of malice runs over their army for the next 9 of their turns. Every turn it winds one notch tighter; on every third notch it discharges, freezing whichever of their pieces is strongest for 2 of their turns, then resets. It cannot be reasoned with, only outlasted - three discharges across its life, each snuffing their best piece for a spell. Their king is never seized.

cards.name: The Inverted Crown
cards.description: The rules of coronation are turned upside down: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn that reaches the last rank is crowned not as they choose but as a mere knight, no matter what they promote to. A knight is still a piece, but never the queen they hoped for. Holding a pawn back until the curse lifts restores a proper coronation.

cards.name: Martyr's Crown
cards.description: A patient briar guards your king for your opponent's next 6 turns. A single check passes unpunished, but on the second time they place your king in check, the thorns lash out: every enemy piece standing next to your king is frozen for 2 of their turns, and the count resets. Persistent, hammering checks are what trigger it - a single decisive check, or threats aimed elsewhere, cost them nothing.

cards.name: I Love My GF
cards.description: Your whole army, king included, cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and you take two extra moves right now.

cards.name: I Love Whimpering Audios
cards.description: On each of your next 3 turns, the enemy queen, rook, bishop, or knight nearest your king is charmed and joins your army. Kings never fall for it.

cards.name: Immortal King
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 8 turns. You can still lose by running out of moves.

cards.name: Leaden Limbs
cards.description: Your opponent may move each piece at most one square in any direction for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Mass Mind Control
cards.description: Take control of two enemy pieces of any type below queen, for the game.

cards.name: Basilisk's Stare
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only ever shuffle one square at a time. Its gaze lingers, so any enemy piece that ends a move next to the statue is frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Peace of the Grave
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture with any piece for their next 3 turns, and for those turns they cannot move any piece onto a square next to your king.

cards.name: Petrified Forest
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 4 of their turns, and the forest has roots: any enemy piece that ends a move beside one of the stone trees is entangled and frozen for 1 turn.

cards.name: Philosopher's Stone
cards.description: Press the fabled stone to your ranks and transmute base metal to gold: three of your pawns become queens, once.

cards.name: Phoenix Rebirth
cards.description: Revive every captured piece you have to your half, once.

cards.name: Poisoned Counsel
cards.description: Your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified and does nothing, and the venom drawn from their counsel sweetens yours: your next draft rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Queen Storm
cards.description: Promote all your pawns on your 4th rank or beyond to queens.

cards.name: Reality Warp
cards.description: Rewrite the rules of matter: any two of your pieces, king aside, become queens.

cards.name: Sacked Capital
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns entirely, and their next draft is skipped as well.

cards.name: Scorched Earth
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own 4th, 5th, or 6th ranks for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Sealed Ramparts
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks can never move again for the rest of the game. Their other pieces are unaffected.

cards.name: Summoning Circle
cards.description: Chalk the circle and speak a greater name: a summoned queen steps through onto any empty square and serves for 6 of your turns before the circle pulls her back.

cards.name: Sundering
cards.description: Three files become impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Time Lock
cards.description: Lock your opponent's clock and hand: they skip their next turn, and their next draft is skipped, once.

cards.name: Time Prison
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next three turns, but the prison is fragile: if you capture anything while it holds, it shatters and their remaining skipped turns are refunded.

cards.name: Titan
cards.description: One piece gains amazon movement for the rest of the game and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns.

cards.name: Total Annihilation
cards.description: Choose any square: every enemy piece except a king standing on it or beside it is removed from the board. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

cards.name: Total Atomic
cards.description: Every capture by your pieces detonates two squares in every direction and each removed piece chains its own blast, for the game.

cards.name: Total Plunder
cards.description: Steal all your opponent's active buffs except locked-in upgrades.

cards.name: Total Warp
cards.description: Teleport your whole army except the king anywhere you like, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

cards.name: Transcendence
cards.description: Remove your nerf for good. Your next draft shows three cards.

cards.name: The Void Realm
cards.description: Three squares you pick become voids for the game: any enemy piece except a king that enters one, or ends its move beside one, is swallowed.

cards.name: Stoneskin
cards.description: Your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every enemy piece standing next to one of your pieces is locked in place for its next turn.

cards.name: World End
cards.description: The edges of the world crumble away: your opponent can never move onto the outer rim of the board again, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.description: The lights go out: your opponent's next 3 turns are skipped entirely.

cards.name: The Culling
cards.description: At the start of each of your next 2 turns, a random enemy piece other than the king is captured.

cards.name: Grand Conjunction
cards.description: Every sign, sphere, and spirit aligns at once: all enemy pieces except the king are frozen for 2 of their turns, and none of your pieces can be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Ice Age
cards.description: Every enemy piece other than the king freezes solid and cannot move for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Iron Legion
cards.description: A relief force arrives: place a queen, a rook and a knight on empty squares in your half.

cards.name: Living God
cards.description: One piece gains amazon movement and explosive captures for the game, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns. An uncapturable piece may never capture the king itself.

cards.name: Mass Petrify
cards.description: Every enemy queen, rook, knight and bishop turns to stone for your opponent's next 3 turns. A petrified piece may only shuffle one square.

cards.name: Queen's Apocalypse
cards.description: Your queen wipes every enemy piece off the board except their king and queen, once. Requires a queen.

cards.name: Regicide
cards.description: Your queen teleports to an empty square next to the enemy king (or the nearest empty square to it) and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece beside the king freezes for those 2 turns.

cards.name: Resurrection
cards.description: Every piece your opponent has captured returns to the board, filling empty squares in your half from your back rank outward and spilling into the rest of the board if your half runs out of room.

cards.name: Second Coming
cards.description: Summon a queen on an empty square in your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Titan Legion
cards.description: Three of your pieces become amazons for the game, uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns.

cards.name: Ascendancy
cards.description: For your next 3 turns every one of your pieces except the king moves and captures as an amazon (a queen that also leaps like a knight), and your king cannot be captured.

cards.name: Grand Army
cards.description: A whole fresh army answers your call: a new queen, two rooks, two bishops and two knights appear on empty squares in your half, and every remaining empty square in your half fills with a new pawn. It spills onto the rest of the board only if your half runs out of room.

cards.name: Oblivion
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's pieces except the king is destroyed, every piece you have ever lost returns to your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn. Only their lone king is left standing against your full force.

cards.name: Total War
cards.description: Every enemy piece except the king is destroyed, a fresh force of a queen, two rooks, two bishops and two knights lands in your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Cess
cards.description: You can't move to the h-file.

cards.name: Escort Mission
cards.description: If your king can capture, it must.

cards.name: Flat Footed
cards.description: Your pawns can't advance two squares.

cards.name: Homebody King
cards.description: Your king can't leave your first two ranks.

cards.name: Keep Off the Grass
cards.description: Your king can't move onto the four center squares.

cards.name: Knights Off the Rail
cards.description: Your knights can't move to the a-file or h-file.

cards.name: Level Headed
cards.description: Your queen can't move diagonally more than 3 squares.

cards.name: Lucky
cards.description: You have no nerf. A rare gift from the gods of chess.

cards.name: No Drawbridge
cards.description: You can't castle.

cards.name: Squeamish
cards.description: Your pawns can't make the game's first capture.

cards.name: No Stone Cutting
cards.description: You can't capture bishops.

cards.name: Gentle Shepherds
cards.description: Your bishops can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Late Riser
cards.description: Your queen can't move during your first four moves. From your fifth move on she is free.

cards.name: Opening Ceremony
cards.description: Your very first move of the game must be a pawn move.

cards.name: Silent Infantry
cards.description: Your pawns can't give check: any pawn move that would leave the enemy king in check is forbidden. A pawn may still capture the king itself.

cards.name: Pen Pusher
cards.description: Your rooks can't capture.

cards.name: Quit Horsing Around
cards.description: If you moved a knight last move, you can't move a knight this move.

cards.name: Right Handed
cards.description: You can't move to the a-file.

cards.name: Separation Anxiety
cards.description: Pawns adjacent to your king can't move away from him.

cards.name: Soft Paws
cards.description: Your knights can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Teetotaler
cards.description: You can't capture rooks.

cards.name: Untitled duck nerf
cards.description: A duck occupies one random square (shown on the board) all game. No piece may land on it and sliding pieces can't pass through it, but knights may still leap over it.

cards.name: Edge-Shy Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't move onto the a-file or the h-file.

cards.name: Moonlit King
cards.description: Your king can only move to dark squares.

cards.name: No Takebacks
cards.description: You can't move a piece to the exact square your last move started from.

cards.name: Wallflower
cards.description: Your rooks can't move onto the four center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5).

cards.name: Advancing Faith
cards.description: Your bishops must gain ground on every move: each bishop move has to advance toward the enemy, never staying level and never falling back.

cards.name: Battle Fatigue
cards.description: After a piece captures, it can't capture again until it makes a non-capturing move.

cards.name: Cavalry Charge
cards.description: Your knights can't move backward toward your own side.

cards.name: Clergy
cards.description: Your bishops can't move backward toward your own side; each bishop move must stay level or advance toward the enemy.

cards.name: Columnar Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks glide any distance up and down a file, but can only shuffle one square at a time sideways along a rank.

cards.name: Cramped Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks can't move more than 4 squares.

cards.name: Greedy
cards.description: You can't capture a lesser piece when a higher-value capture is on the table. You may still play a quiet move.

cards.name: Just Passing Through
cards.description: Can't capture on a random rank.

cards.name: Knights Abroad
cards.description: Once one of your knights crosses into the enemy half, it can't come back to your own half.

cards.name: Merciful Queen
cards.description: Your queen won't cut down the common soldiers: she can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Monastic Vows
cards.description: Your bishops can't capture.

cards.name: Clean Hands
cards.description: Your king can't capture anything.

cards.name: Cold Trail
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto the square your opponent's last move just left.

cards.name: Minor Nobility
cards.description: Your pawns can only promote to knights or bishops, never to queens or rooks.

cards.name: Rusty Hinges
cards.description: You can only castle during your first ten moves. From your 11th move on, the castle gate is rusted shut.

cards.name: Orthodox King
cards.description: Your king can only move horizontally or vertically, never diagonally.

cards.name: Pawn Ceiling
cards.description: Your pawns can't move past the middle of the board.

cards.name: Prima Donna
cards.description: Can't have more than one pawn on the same file.

cards.name: Professional Courtesy
cards.description: Non-pawn pieces can't capture pieces of their own type.

cards.name: Queen Bee
cards.description: Once you capture with your queen, you can no longer move queens.

cards.name: Queen Disguise
cards.description: Your queen is secretly either a rook or a bishop. Once you move it like one, you can't move it like the other.

cards.name: Queen Fatigue
cards.description: You lose if you move your queen more than 12 times.

cards.name: Rook Buddies
cards.description: Your rooks can't move while any piece sits between them on your home rank; clear the back rank between them first.

cards.name: Rusty Knights
cards.description: Knights can only move once every other turn.

cards.name: Sacred File
cards.description: A random file is sacred. You can't capture on it.

cards.name: Separation of Church and State
cards.description: Can't move bishops next to a king and can't move king next to a bishop.

cards.name: Shadow Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move to dark squares.

cards.name: Skittish
cards.description: While in check, you must move your king.

cards.name: Sleepy King
cards.description: Your king can only move when in check.

cards.name: Truant
cards.description: You can't move the same piece twice in a row.

cards.name: True Gentleman
cards.description: You can't capture queens.

cards.name: Vegan
cards.description: You can't capture knights.

cards.name: Gentle Giant
cards.description: Your queen can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Knight Toll
cards.description: You can't capture with a knight if a knight of yours captured on your previous turn.

cards.name: No Going Home
cards.description: Your non-pawn pieces can't move back onto your own back rank.

cards.name: Sabbath
cards.description: On every 7th turn of yours, you can't capture.

cards.name: Artillery
cards.description: Rooks must capture at distance ≥ 4.

cards.name: Blinded by the Sun
cards.description: Can't end turn attacking a random square.

cards.name: Carnivore Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops can only move when they capture.

cards.name: Cautious Cavalry
cards.description: Your knights can't cross into the enemy half of the board.

cards.name: Comfort Zone
cards.description: If you can move to a random square X, you must.

cards.name: Conscientious Objectors
cards.description: Your pawns can't capture.

cards.name: Court Martial
cards.description: A piece that's attacked at turn start can't capture.

cards.name: Crossing the Rubicon
cards.description: Once a piece crosses to the opponent's half, it can't return.

cards.name: Diplomatic Immunity
cards.description: Can't capture a piece that just moved, unless that move was a capture.

cards.name: Elephants Fear Mice
cards.description: Your non-pawn pieces can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Entrenched
cards.description: Rooks can't move more than 2 squares.

cards.name: Evil Twin
cards.description: If you can capture a piece with a same-type piece, you must.

cards.name: Famine
cards.description: After move 15, you can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Femme Fatale
cards.description: You can only capture the enemy king with your queen.

cards.name: Goldfish
cards.description: You can't move a piece you moved 3 turns ago.

cards.name: Half a Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move like a rook, never diagonally.

cards.name: Haunted
cards.description: Can't move to a square where you've previously captured.

cards.name: Heavy Boots
cards.description: All non-pawn moves are distance ≤ 3.

cards.name: Hipster
cards.description: You can't move the same piece type as your opponent's last move.

cards.name: Horse Tranquilizer
cards.description: Your knights can't capture.

cards.name: Ichthyophobe
cards.description: Each turn you can't play the move a simple greedy engine would pick (its single best move by a one ply look: the most valuable safe capture, or a basic developing move when there is no capture). Every other legal move is fine; if that one move is your only legal move, you may still play it.

cards.name: Knight Parade
cards.description: You must move each knight at least once before moving the same knight twice.

cards.name: No Free Lunch
cards.description: No even trades: you can't capture a piece worth exactly as much as the piece making the capture.

cards.name: No Retreat
cards.description: Your king can't step backward toward your own back rank.

cards.name: No Shuffling
cards.description: Your rooks can't move sideways.

cards.name: One Bite at a Time
cards.description: After a capture, you can't capture again for two of your turns.

cards.name: One Way Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops can't retreat on a quiet move, but they may still strike backward: a bishop may only lose rank when the move is a capture.

cards.name: Out of Breath
cards.description: You can only move your king once the entire game.

cards.name: Outflanked
cards.description: You can't capture on the rim. The enemy king is fair game anywhere.

cards.name: Overzealous
cards.description: You lose if you capture more than 10 enemy pieces.

cards.name: Pawn Duty
cards.description: Every third turn, you must move a pawn.

cards.name: Peons First
cards.description: Can't move pieces that are one square behind one of your pawns.

cards.name: Promotion Phobia
cards.description: Your pawns can't promote. They get stuck on the back rank.

cards.name: Protected Pawns
cards.description: Can only move pawns to defended squares.

cards.name: Pull of the Center
cards.description: Your pawns can only capture toward the center files.

cards.name: Punching Down
cards.description: Pieces can't capture pieces worth more than themselves.

cards.name: Remorseful
cards.description: Can't capture twice in a row.

cards.name: Royal Guard
cards.description: Your non-king pieces that are adjacent to your king at the start of your turn can't move. The king itself may still move.

cards.name: Royal Jubilee
cards.description: Whenever you capture a non-pawn, you must move your king or queen on the next move.

cards.name: Shellshocked
cards.description: When opponent captures, pieces adjacent to the captured square can't move next turn.

cards.name: Sibling Rivalry
cards.description: Can't move a piece adjacent to an opponent's piece of same type.

cards.name: Sidewinder
cards.description: Your rooks can only move horizontally along ranks, never up or down files.

cards.name: Simplifier
cards.description: If you can capture with an equal- or lesser-value piece, you must.

cards.name: Snipers
cards.description: Bishops can only capture from distance ≥ 4.

cards.name: Spice of Life
cards.description: You can't move the same piece type twice in a row.

cards.name: Stir Crazy
cards.description: If you haven't moved your king for 4 turns, you must on the 5th.

cards.name: Stop Stalling
cards.description: Your pieces can't move laterally.

cards.name: Superstitious
cards.description: Can't move to a square where opponent has captured.

cards.name: Three Check
cards.description: If you have been checked three times total, you lose.

cards.name: Timid
cards.description: Your pieces can't capture an enemy worth more than the capturing piece, unless that capturing piece is itself under enemy attack.

cards.name: Trophy Wife
cards.description: Your queen can't capture.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.description: Can't move a piece more than 2 ranks in one move.

cards.name: Whites of Their Eyes
cards.description: You can only capture within 2 squares (king-steps) of the capturing piece.

cards.name: Flinch
cards.description: While your king is in check, you can't capture; you have to get out another way.

cards.name: Lonely King
cards.description: Your king can't move to a square adjacent to one of your own pieces.

cards.name: Pawn Shy
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto a square guarded by an enemy pawn.

cards.name: Short Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't move more than 4 squares in a single move.

cards.name: Slow Burn
cards.description: You can't capture anything before your 6th move.

cards.name: Slow Start
cards.description: For your first 6 moves, you can only move pawns and knights.

cards.name: Stampede
cards.description: If you moved a knight on your last turn, you must move a knight again this turn (if you can).

cards.name: Active Volcano
cards.description: Can't move onto or orthogonally adjacent to a random square.

cards.name: Alternator
cards.description: You must alternate pawn moves and non-pawn moves.

cards.name: Barbarian Rage
cards.description: If you captured last move, you must capture this move if able.

cards.name: Bipartisanship
cards.description: Can't move left twice in a row or right twice in a row.

cards.name: Bishop Fan Club
cards.description: Must promote to bishops. King and queen can only move diagonally.

cards.name: Bishop Tunnel Vision
cards.description: Your bishops can't move more than three squares in a single move.

cards.name: Castle Curfew
cards.description: You lose if you have not castled by your 20th move.

cards.name: Champing at the Bit
cards.description: All pawn moves must be distance 2.

cards.name: Chivalry
cards.description: Can only capture heavies (rooks, queens) with a knight.

cards.name: Control Center
cards.description: Non-capturing moves must go to files c, d, e, or f.

cards.name: Court Jester
cards.description: Your queen can only move like a knight.

cards.name: Doctor Octopus
cards.description: Can only capture non-king pieces 8 times total.

cards.name: Eat Your Vegetables
cards.description: Can't capture non-pawns until opponent has ≤ 4 pawns remaining.

cards.name: Even Keeled
cards.description: Can only capture on even-numbered moves.

cards.name: Fair Fight
cards.description: You can't capture a piece worth less than the piece making the capture; no bullying weaker pieces, only equal or stronger prey.

cards.name: Far Sighted
cards.description: You can't capture a piece standing right next to the capturing piece; captures must reach at least 2 squares away.

cards.name: Frozen Cavalry
cards.description: From your 18th move on, you can't move your knights.

cards.name: Gambler
cards.description: Can't move a specific piece type, re-randomized each turn.

cards.name: Get Down Mr. President
cards.description: Can't move your king while in check.

cards.name: Honey Trap
cards.description: Your queen can't move unless she is currently under attack by an enemy piece.

cards.name: Hungry Pawns
cards.description: Whenever one of your pawns can capture, you must make a capture with a pawn.

cards.name: Inside the Lines
cards.description: You can't move ONTO the rim. Pieces already on the rim may stay there.

cards.name: Ivory Tower
cards.description: You lose if any opponent piece is adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Kingfisher
cards.description: When your king can capture, it must dive for the richest prize: it has to take the most valuable enemy piece within its reach.

cards.name: Ladies First
cards.description: Can only move king if you moved queen on previous turn.

cards.name: Leading the Charge
cards.description: As long as you have a knight, non-knights can't be ahead of your most advanced knight.

cards.name: Left for Dead
cards.description: Can only capture leftward (file decreasing).

cards.name: Messy Divorce
cards.description: Pieces can't move from queenside to kingside or vice versa.

cards.name: Moving Day
cards.description: After turn 20, no piece may be on your home row.

cards.name: No Retreat Rooks
cards.description: From your 10th move on, your rooks can't move toward your own back rank.

cards.name: Oddball
cards.description: Can only capture on odd-numbered moves.

cards.name: Pack Mentality
cards.description: Pieces must move to squares adjacent to another of your pieces.

cards.name: Pacman
cards.description: If you can capture a pawn, you must.

cards.name: Phobia of Edges
cards.description: If a piece is on the rim, it must move.

cards.name: Power Cells
cards.description: Can't move a piece farther than the number of pawns you have.

cards.name: Prince Charming
cards.description: If your queen is attacked, must move a knight if possible.

cards.name: Quarantine
cards.description: You can't move a piece into your own first two ranks from outside them (pieces already on those ranks may still move within them). Separately, while your king is in check, only your king may move.

cards.name: Queen Grounded
cards.description: From your 12th move on, your queen can't move into the opponent's half of the board.

cards.name: Quicksand
cards.description: The 4th and 5th ranks are quicksand. If one of your pieces lands on the same 4th or 5th rank square for the second time in the game (tracing that piece's own path, not necessarily on consecutive moves), it is stuck and can never move from that square again.

cards.name: Rook Fan Club
cards.description: Must promote to rooks. King/queen can't move diagonally.

cards.name: Rooks Charge
cards.description: Your rooks can only move straight forward toward the enemy, never sideways or backward.

cards.name: Royal Bloodlust
cards.description: The turn after your king captures, you must make a capture with any piece if you can.

cards.name: Scholarship
cards.description: You can only move a piece type after the opponent has moved it once.

cards.name: Scouting Ahead
cards.description: As long as you have a pawn, non-pawns can't go ahead of your most advanced pawn.

cards.name: Shapeshifter
cards.description: Queen starts as a bishop. When you capture a non-pawn, queen becomes a copy of that piece. Capturing a knight freezes her.

cards.name: Simp
cards.description: You lose if you have no queen.

cards.name: Social Distancing
cards.description: Can't make non-capturing moves to squares adjacent to opponent pieces.

cards.name: Solar Flare
cards.description: You can only capture on light squares.

cards.name: Stay-at-Home Mom
cards.description: Your queen can only move within your two home ranks.

cards.name: Sunrise
cards.description: On odd turns you must move forward; on even turns you may move freely.

cards.name: Switchback
cards.description: You can't move in the exact same direction (same file and rank step) twice in a row.

cards.name: Thinning Ranks
cards.description: You lose if you are ever left with fewer than three pawns.

cards.name: Torpedoes
cards.description: If you made a non-capturing pawn move last turn and can move it again, you must.

cards.name: Tripwire
cards.description: A random rank is a tripwire. You can't cross it backwards.

cards.name: Turn the Other Cheek
cards.description: Can't recapture.

cards.name: Vampiric
cards.description: You can only capture on dark squares.

cards.name: War of Attrition
cards.description: You lose if you ever make more than twelve non-capturing moves in a row.

cards.name: Warlord
cards.description: From turn 12 onward, your king can't be on your first two ranks.

cards.name: Winds of Fate
cards.description: Each turn, randomly can't move left or can't move right.

cards.name: Windup Toys
cards.description: After move 12, can't move knights or bishops.

cards.name: Curfew
cards.description: After your 25th move, you can't move any piece into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

cards.name: Glass Jaw
cards.description: You can't make a move that leaves your queen attacked by the enemy.

cards.name: Quarantine Zone
cards.description: A random 2x2 block of squares is sealed off at game start; you can't move any piece onto it.

cards.name: Shifting Sands
cards.description: Each turn, a random file is closed; you can't move any piece onto it this turn.

cards.name: Tax Season
cards.description: Every 6th turn of yours, if you can capture, you must.

cards.name: Weigh Station
cards.description: Your rooks and queen can't cross into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

cards.name: Blood Quota
cards.description: You may make only six captures all game; you lose if you make a seventh.

cards.name: Cheerleaders
cards.description: Non-pawns can only capture if adjacent to one of your pawns.

cards.name: Colorblind
cards.description: Can't move to one random color of squares, re-randomized each turn.

cards.name: Counting Sheep
cards.description: Once you've moved a piece type 5 times, you can't move it again.

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.description: Can only capture a piece if you can capture it two different ways.

cards.name: Cowering in Fear
cards.description: Can't move a piece of less value than one opponent has captured from you.

cards.name: Crenellations
cards.description: Pawns can only move to a random color of squares.

cards.name: Crusade
cards.description: For 4 moves starting on a random move, must end turn on a specific random square.

cards.name: Defanged Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't capture and can't give check.

cards.name: Drag
cards.description: Your queen is now royal: if it is captured, you lose.

cards.name: Eye for an Eye
cards.description: If opponent captures, you must capture next turn or lose.

cards.name: Eye of Sauron
cards.description: As long as you have a rook, non-pawns can't go past the rook's farthest sight.

cards.name: Flatterer
cards.description: If opponent moves a pawn, you must move a pawn. Same for non-pawns.

cards.name: Forward March
cards.description: You can't move backward.

cards.name: Fresh Faces
cards.description: Each turn, you must move a piece that hasn't moved yet, until none remain.

cards.name: Guerilla Tactics
cards.description: After a capturing move, you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible.

cards.name: Hedonic Treadmill
cards.description: Must move a piece at least as valuable as opponent's last moved piece.

cards.name: Hobbled Knights
cards.description: Your knights can't advance toward the enemy side; their rank may never increase.

cards.name: Homebound Pawns
cards.description: Your pawns can't advance past the halfway line unless the move is a capture; only by force can they cross into enemy soil.

cards.name: Hopscotch
cards.description: Must alternate light/dark destination squares.

cards.name: Horse Eats First
cards.description: As long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights.

cards.name: Indecisive
cards.description: Pieces can't capture if they have multiple possible capture moves.

cards.name: Irresistible
cards.description: If you can move a piece adjacent to opponent's king (that isn't already), you must.

cards.name: Jumpy
cards.description: When possible, must move an attacked piece.

cards.name: Lame Duck
cards.description: You can't move your king at all.

cards.name: Lethal Attraction
cards.description: Can't make moves that move a piece farther from opponent's king than it started.

cards.name: Magnetic Kings
cards.description: When you move your king, it must not end up farther from the enemy king than it started (equal distance is allowed). Moving any other piece is unrestricted.

cards.name: Medusa
cards.description: Pieces attacked by opponent's queen are stone; they cannot move.

cards.name: Mirror March
cards.description: Your move must go the same file direction (left or right) as your opponent's last move.

cards.name: Myopic Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops can't move more than two squares.

cards.name: No Man's Land
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto a square your opponent currently attacks.

cards.name: No Retreat Ever
cards.description: Every move you make must advance toward the enemy; no piece may move backward or even hold its rank.

cards.name: Pawn Storm
cards.description: If your last move wasn't a pawn move, you must move a pawn (if possible).

cards.name: Pawns Do the Dirty Work
cards.description: Only your pawns may capture; none of your other pieces can capture.

cards.name: Reconnaissance
cards.description: Start unable to capture. After seeing each opponent piece type move, you may capture that type.

cards.name: Relay Race
cards.description: If you can move a piece adjacent to your last move's destination, you must.

cards.name: Respectful
cards.description: You can't end your turn giving check.

cards.name: Restless Crown
cards.description: Your king may move only six times all game; you lose on his seventh move.

cards.name: Rising Water
cards.description: Every 10 of your turns, water rises one rank from your back rank. You can't move underwater pieces or to underwater squares.

cards.name: Rook on the Seventh
cards.description: By move 15, you must have a rook on your 7th rank.

cards.name: Royal Berth
cards.description: Can't place a piece adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Savior Complex
cards.description: When in check, must move your queen, or lose.

cards.name: Scorched Earth
cards.description: You can't move to a square you've previously moved FROM.

cards.name: Simon Says
cards.description: Must move onto same color square as opponent's last move.

cards.name: Spread Out
cards.description: Can't move a non-pawn adjacent to another of your non-pawns. Can't castle.

cards.name: Stand Your Ground
cards.description: Pieces can only capture if attacked.

cards.name: Stunted Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks can only move one square at a time.

cards.name: Theocracy
cards.description: On odd/even moves, can only capture with bishops.

cards.name: Tidy Desk
cards.description: By move 25, you must have at least one piece on each rank of your half.

cards.name: Torchlight
cards.description: Non-pawns can only move if start or end square is adjacent to one of your pawns.

cards.name: Tower Defense
cards.description: Can't move rooks. If you lose all rooks, you lose.

cards.name: Triple Play
cards.description: Can only capture the enemy king if you have 3 of a random piece type.

cards.name: True Love
cards.description: King and queen can only move to squares adjacent to each other.

cards.name: Unspooling
cards.description: Total move distance budget = 100. When you run out, you lose.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.description: You lose if your king ever has no friendly piece adjacent to it (after your first move).

cards.name: Bottom Feeder
cards.description: You can only capture pawns. You can't capture any other piece, except the enemy king to win.

cards.name: Follow the Leader
cards.description: You must move a piece onto the same file as your opponent's last move's destination, if you can.

cards.name: Gravity
cards.description: None of your pieces may move more than two ranks ahead of your own king.

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.description: Each turn, five random squares are struck and sealed; you can't move any piece onto them this turn.

cards.name: Mimicry
cards.description: You must move the same piece type as your opponent's last move, if you can.

cards.name: You Best Not Miss
cards.description: If you end your turn giving check, you must capture the king next turn or lose.

cards.name: Absolution
cards.description: After a non-bishop captures, it must start a turn adjacent to a bishop before it can capture again.

cards.name: Anchored Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks may never leave your back rank.

cards.name: Armory
cards.description: Your rooks must stay defended at all times.

cards.name: Ascetic
cards.description: You can capture at most one piece per piece type.

cards.name: Bloodthirsty
cards.description: After turn 3, if you go 2 turns without capturing, you must capture if able.

cards.name: Boxing with Shadow
cards.description: When opponent moves, if you can move to the square they vacated, you must.

cards.name: Bridge Over Troubled Water
cards.description: A river runs through the middle. Cross only via the center files.

cards.name: Burning Bridges
cards.description: Your bishops, rooks, and queen can't travel over a square they have already passed over earlier in the game.

cards.name: Caged Queen
cards.description: Your queen may never leave your own back rank.

cards.name: Centralized Command
cards.description: Can only capture if you moved your king in last 3 turns.

cards.name: Checkers
cards.description: Must capture if able.

cards.name: Closed Book
cards.description: You lose if two or more files ever have none of your pawns on them.

cards.name: Constriction
cards.description: Every 6 of your turns, the playable board loses a rank from the back, up to 3 ranks.

cards.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
cards.description: Each turn the devil suggests a bad move. Ignore him 7 turns in a row and on the 8th you must obey.

cards.name: Domino
cards.description: Each move must end adjacent to your previous move's destination.

cards.name: Echo Chamber
cards.description: You must move to the same rank as your last move's destination.

cards.name: Exclusivity Clause
cards.description: Can't move to squares more than one of your pieces can move to.

cards.name: Feast or Famine
cards.description: You lose if twelve of your turns pass in a row without you capturing anything.

cards.name: Fog of War
cards.description: You can't see opponent's pieces (except when capturing, captures, or check).

cards.name: Friendly Fire
cards.description: Can only move to squares defended by another of your pieces.

cards.name: Going the Distance
cards.description: Must move at least as far as opponent's last move, if able.

cards.name: Hand and Brainless
cards.description: Each turn, a random piece type. You must move that type if possible.

cards.name: Helicopter Parent
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with a pawn that is attacked and undefended.

cards.name: Homeland Security
cards.description: If opponent enters your two home ranks, you lose.

cards.name: Icy Squares
cards.description: After you move a piece, it must slide once more in the same direction on your next move (if possible). Forced slides don't force another.

cards.name: Inching Forward
cards.description: After turn 6, king must be in front of home rank. Required rank advances every 6 turns, up to your 7th rank.

cards.name: Iron Curtain
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto the central 16 squares (files c through f, ranks 3 through 6).

cards.name: King of the Hill
cards.description: After your first move, you lose unless one of your pieces sits on d4, d5, e4, or e5.

cards.name: Leaps and Bounds
cards.description: Every move must be a leap: a piece can't move to a square adjacent to the square it's leaving.

cards.name: Left to Right
cards.description: Unless you just moved to the rightmost file, must move right of your last move's destination.

cards.name: Leveling Up
cards.description: Can't capture a piece type until you've captured its predecessor.

cards.name: Modest
cards.description: Lose if you have more pieces than opponent.

cards.name: Monkey See
cards.description: Can only capture with piece types your opponent has captured with.

cards.name: No Clean Trades
cards.description: You can't make a capture if the enemy could immediately recapture on that square.

cards.name: No Hanging Pieces
cards.description: You can't make a move that leaves any of your pieces attacked by the enemy and undefended.

cards.name: Nurturer
cards.description: Can't capture the enemy king until you've promoted a pawn.

cards.name: Obsession
cards.description: Each turn, a random square. If you can move to it, you must.

cards.name: Paranoid
cards.description: Your king must always be defended, or you lose.

cards.name: Rhythm Master
cards.description: You must alternate captures and non-captures.

cards.name: The Scent of Blood
cards.description: Any of your pieces that has a capture available can't make a non-capturing move; if you move that piece, it must capture. You may still move a different piece that has no capture.

cards.name: Secret Garden
cards.description: Two random garden zones (each a 3-file-wide, 3-rank-deep block in front of one of your pawns, shown as marked squares) are off limits for the whole game: you can't move any piece onto those squares.

cards.name: Short Leash Knights
cards.description: Your knights may never move beyond your own first three ranks.

cards.name: Siege
cards.description: You must capture at least one enemy rook by move 20, or you lose.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: All your moves must be distance exactly 1.

cards.name: Statue King
cards.description: Your king can only move to capture; he can never take a quiet, non-capturing step.

cards.name: Taking Turns
cards.description: Can't move a piece a second time until every piece of its type has moved once.

cards.name: Thunderdome
cards.description: The center 16 squares (files c to f, ranks 3 to 6) are the thunderdome. Once one of your pieces is on those squares it can never move out of the zone for the rest of the game (it may still move within the zone). Pieces enter; pieces do not leave.

cards.name: Timid Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops may only move toward your own side; their rank can never advance toward the enemy.

cards.name: Toothless Pawns
cards.description: Your pawns can never capture and can never move two squares.

cards.name: Tribute
cards.description: Every 8th turn, if you can push a pawn onto a square the enemy attacks, you must.

cards.name: Unlucky
cards.description: Half the squares are unusable each turn, re-randomized.

cards.name: Unrequited Love
cards.description: King can't move away from queen; queen can't move toward king.

cards.name: Vanishing Point
cards.description: Your pieces can't move to the same square twice in the game.

cards.name: Daisy Chain
cards.description: The piece you move must start its move adjacent to the square your last move ended on (if any such move exists).

cards.name: Deadline
cards.description: You must capture the enemy queen by your 25th move, or you lose.

cards.name: Equalizer
cards.description: You lose if your piece count ever differs from your opponent's by more than 3, in either direction.

cards.name: King's Leash
cards.description: You can't move any piece to a square more than 3 king-steps from your own king.

cards.name: Regicide Clock
cards.description: You must give check at least once every 8 of your turns, or you lose.

cards.name: Abstinence
cards.description: If your opponent ever has two same-type non-pawns adjacent inside your half of the board, you lose.

cards.name: Always Check, It Might Be Mate
cards.description: If you are checked, you lose.

cards.name: Boastful
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with fewer pieces than your opponent.

cards.name: Broadside Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks glide any distance sideways along a rank, but can only inch one square at a time up or down a file.

cards.name: Cloistered Queen
cards.description: Your queen stays cloistered and cannot move at all until you have castled.

cards.name: No Restraint
cards.description: If you can capture you must, and if any available capture also gives check, you must make a checking capture.

cards.name: Cowardly
cards.description: When opponent captures, you must move backward, or lose.

cards.name: Deer in the Headlights
cards.description: You can't move pieces that are currently under attack.

cards.name: Fischer Random Endgame
cards.description: By move 20, all your non-pawns must be on home row AND on a square they couldn't have started on.

cards.name: Fog of War (extended)
cards.description: Hide opponent pieces entirely.

cards.name: Glorious Battle
cards.description: On a midgame move drawn at random (you are warned two turns ahead), the battle begins: for 3 consecutive moves you must capture, or lose.

cards.name: My Kingdom for a Horse
cards.description: If opponent captures a knight of yours, you lose.

cards.name: Noble Steed
cards.description: Non-knight pieces can only move if adjacent to one of your knights.

cards.name: Chameleon
cards.description: Every move must end on the same color square it started on. That means your knights can never move, your pawns can only double-step or capture, and your king and rooks step diagonally or an even number of squares.

cards.name: Grandstanding
cards.description: Every move you make must be one of the longest available this turn: no legal move may travel farther (in king-steps) than the one you pick.

cards.name: Metronome
cards.description: Each move must travel exactly as many squares (king-steps) as your previous move, whenever such a move exists. A knight's move always counts as two.

cards.name: Royal Entourage
cards.description: You can only move pieces that start within two king-steps of your own king. Everything farther away stands and waits.

cards.name: Onward Only
cards.description: From your 8th move on, none of your pieces may move backward toward your own back rank.

cards.name: Pilgrimage
cards.description: Your king must reach the opposite back rank by move 30.

cards.name: Predatory Knights
cards.description: Your knights can only move by capturing an enemy piece.

cards.name: Reckless Monarch
cards.description: Whenever your king can step toward the enemy, you must move your king forward.

cards.name: Reflective
cards.description: Non-pawns must move to squares whose mirror across the center is occupied.

cards.name: Relentless Hunter
cards.description: You must give check on every turn you are able to.

cards.name: Retreating Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops can only ever retreat toward your own back rank; they can never advance and never even hold their rank.

cards.name: Straight and Narrow
cards.description: You can't make any diagonal move: your bishops are stuck, your queen moves only like a rook, and your pawns can't capture.

cards.name: Velociraptor
cards.description: Can only capture a piece type if opponent moved that type in their last 3 moves.

cards.name: War Footing
cards.description: You lose if you make more than 14 non-capturing moves all game.

cards.name: Glass Queen
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with your queen attacked by the enemy.

cards.name: Kingpin
cards.description: Only your king may capture. No other piece can make a capture.

cards.name: Pin Cushion
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with two or more of your pieces (other than the king) attacked by the enemy at once.

cards.name: Royal Meridian
cards.description: Every piece you move must land on your king's file or your king's rank.

cards.name: Bottled Lightning
cards.description: If you can move your king, you must.

cards.name: Crippled Clergy
cards.description: Your bishops can only move one square at a time.

cards.name: Death Wish
cards.description: If you can move king into check, you must.

cards.name: Glass King
cards.description: Your king is made of glass: you lose the instant he is checked while standing beyond your own first two ranks. Kept at home, he can weather a check.

cards.name: Hoarder
cards.description: If you ever have fewer than 8 pawns, you lose the game.

cards.name: Hobbled Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move one square at a time, like a second king.

cards.name: Hold Them Back
cards.description: You lose the moment any enemy pawn reaches your first three ranks.

cards.name: March or Die
cards.description: You lose if six of your turns pass in a row without you moving a pawn.

cards.name: Neat Freak
cards.description: After turn 10, you lose if two of your pieces of the same type (pawns aside) ever share a diagonal.

cards.name: Doomsday Clock
cards.description: You must capture the enemy king by your 45th move. If you make your 45th move and the game is still going, you lose.

cards.name: Killing Spree
cards.description: Once you capture, the spree begins: every one of your following turns must also capture. If you start a turn mid-spree with no capture available, you lose. Capturing the enemy king ends the spree in victory.

cards.name: Pyrrhic Victories
cards.description: Any of your pieces that captures turns to stone and can never move again. Your king is immune to the curse.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.description: Your king must always end your turn with at least one of your own pawns adjacent to him, or you lose. If the shield is broken on the opponent's turn, you get one move to restore it.

cards.name: Own Half Only
cards.description: You can't move any piece past your own fourth rank; the enemy half of the board is off limits.

cards.name: Retrograde Knights
cards.description: Your knights can only move backward toward your own side; a knight's rank can never advance.

cards.name: Serf Labor
cards.description: You can only move your pawns and your king. No other piece may ever move.

cards.name: Total Pacifism
cards.description: You can never capture an enemy piece, except the king to win.

cards.name: Wagon Train
cards.description: Keep the column in its lane: each move must land on the same file as your previous move's destination or a file right next to it.

cards.name: The Floor Is Lava
cards.description: Each turn, four random ranks turn to lava; you can't move a piece from or onto those ranks this turn.

cards.name: Glass Army
cards.description: You lose the moment the opponent captures any of your non-pawn pieces (knight, bishop, rook, or queen).

cards.name: House of Cards
cards.description: From your 6th move on, you lose if you end one of your turns with any of your pieces (other than the king) attacked and undefended.

cards.name: Perfect Defense
cards.description: You can't make any move that leaves one of your pieces (other than the king) standing on a square the enemy attacks, even if it is defended.
